features.description: The async and await keywords allow you to use the asynchronous, promise-based behavior of a function without using promise chains.

features.name: Autonomous custom elements
features.description: Autonomous custom elements are HTML elements with a hyphenated tag name (like <example-element>) that have behaviors you define.

features.name: Device orientation events
features.description: The DeviceMotion and DeviceOrientation events report the movement and orientation of the browser's device in physical space. Note that coordinates can differ noticeably between platforms and devices.

features.name: Host
features.description: The :host CSS pseudo-class selects the containing element of the shadow tree in which it is used. The :host() CSS pseudo-class selects the that element only if it matches the provided selector.

features.name: Media capture
features.description: The navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia() API requests access to devices that produce audio or video streams, such as microphones or video cameras.

features.name: WebP
features.description: The WebP image format is a raster graphics file format that supports animation, alpha transparency, and lossy as well as lossless compression.

features.name: ::placeholder
features.description: The ::placeholder CSS pseudo-element selects help text in <input> and <textarea> elements when no value is set.

features.name: COLRv0
features.description: COLRv0 is a font format that supports multi-color glyphs. COLRv0 supports only solid colors.

features.name: Grid
features.description: CSS grid is a two-dimensional layout system, which lays content out in rows and columns.

features.name: String padStart() and padEnd()
features.description: The padStart() and padEnd() methods of strings return a string lengthened to a minimum number of characters by adding characters to the start or end of the string.

features.name: WebRTC
features.description: The WebRTC API establishes real-time communication channels directly between browsers. It is commonly used in video conferencing applications.

features.name: isSecureContext
features.description: The isSecureContext global property is a boolean for whether the current browsing context is secure. This is primarily a check that the page has been served over an HTTPS URL.

features.name: Link selectors
features.description: The :link CSS pseudo-class matches unvisited links, :visited matches visited links, and :any-link matches both.

features.name: OfflineAudioContext
features.description: The OfflineAudioContext API represents an audio processing graph that writes to an AudioBuffer instead of an output device.

features.name: Web Audio
features.description: The Web Audio API creates graphs of audio nodes that handle sound inputs, synthesize sounds, apply effects, create visualizations, and output to audio devices.

features.name: WebAssembly
features.description: The WebAssembly.instantiate() and WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming() global static methods load WebAssembly code (also known as Wasm), a portable binary instruction format.

features.name: :focus-within
features.description: The :focus-within CSS pseudo-class matches an element if the element or any of its children are focused.

features.name: caret-color
features.description: The caret-color CSS property sets the color of the text insertion pointer in a text input.

features.name: System font
features.description: The font-family: system-ui CSS declaration uses the operating system default font for text.

features.name: tab-size
features.description: The tab-size CSS property sets the width of the tab character.

features.name: WebRTC statistics
features.description: The RTCPeerConnection.getStats(), RTCRtpSender.getStats(), and RTCRtpReceiver.getStats() methods return detailed information about the status, performance, network, and media for a given WebRTC connection.

features.name: <data>
features.description: The <data> element links a given piece of content with a machine-readable translation.

features.name: <time>
features.description: The <time> HTML element represents a time, such as a calendar date, clock time, or duration. It may include the datetime attribute to translate dates into machine-readable format.

features.name: Animatable clipping paths
features.description: The clip-path property can be animated using CSS transitions and animations.

features.name: font-variant-east-asian
features.description: The font-variant-east-asian CSS property controls glyph substitution and sizing in East Asian text.

features.name: WEBGL_debug_shaders WebGL extension
features.description: The WEBGL_debug_shaders extension for WebGL 1.0 and 2.0 contexts adds the getTranslatedShaderSource() method to debug shaders from privileged contexts.

features.name: CSS.supports()
features.description: The CSS.supports() static method returns whether the browser supports a CSS declaration (given by two arguments, a property and value) or an @supports at-rule condition string.

features.name: DOM Geometry
features.description: The DOMMatrix, DOMPoint, DOMQuad and DOMRect APIs represent points, rectangles, quadrilaterals and transformation matrices within JavaScript. They can be used in transformations in CSS, <canvas>, and SVG.

features.name: font-variation-settings
features.description: The font-variation-settings CSS property sets an "axis of variability" on a variable font, such as weight, optical size, or a custom axis defined by the typeface designer. When possible, use other CSS font properties, such as font-weight: bold. Also known as variable fonts.

features.name: Intersection observer
features.description: The IntersectionObserver API asynchronously observes changes in the intersection of a target element with an ancestor element or with a top-level document's viewport.

features.name: JavaScript modules
features.description: JavaScript modules allow code to be organized into reusable units. Modules use import to load other modules and export to declare what is available to import from other modules. In HTML, modules are loaded with <script type="module">.

features.name: MediaStream recording
features.description: The MediaRecorder API captures data generated by MediaStream or HTMLMediaElement objects for analysis, processing, or saving to disk. Also known as the Media Recording API.

features.name: Pointer Events
features.description: Pointer events, such as pointerdown, and the PointerEvent API, represent general pointing inputs, from a wide range of devices, such as a mouse, pen or stylus, or touch with one or more fingers. Not to be confused with the pointer-events CSS property.

features.name: Sticky positioning
features.description: The position: sticky CSS declaration positions an element in the normal flow until it crosses a specified threshold, at which points it becomes fixed (stuck) at that position.

features.name: Template literals
features.description: Template literals are literals delimited with backtick (`) characters, allowing for multi-line strings, string interpolation with embedded expressions, and special constructs called tagged templates.

features.name: text-decoration-line: blink
features.description: The text-decoration: blink CSS declaration flashes text between visible and invisible.

features.name: text-orientation
features.description: The text-orientation CSS property sets the how text is typeset within a line when the writing mode is vertical.

features.name: WEBGL_compressed_texture_etc1 WebGL extension
features.description: The WEBGL_compressed_texture_etc1 extension for WebGL 1.0 and 2.0 contexts adds the ETC1 compressed texture format to compressedTexImage2D() and compressedTexSubImage2D().

features.name: ::backdrop
features.description: The ::backdrop CSS pseudo-element is a box underneath an element in the top layer, such as a <dialog>. It can be used to create obscuring effects distinguishing a modal element from the elements underneath.

features.name: 3D transforms
features.description: The transform CSS property and its 3D transform functions allow rotations and other transforms in three dimensions, including perspective transforms.

features.name: Array iterators
features.description: Arrays are iterable with the for … of statement and enumerable with the methods entries(), keys(), and values().

features.name: Destructuring
features.description: The destructuring assignment syntax is a JavaScript expression that unpacks values from arrays, or properties from objects, into distinct variables.

features.name: display: flow-root
features.description: The display: flow-root CSS declaration sets an element as the root element of a new flow layout for its children, preventing margin collapse with sibling elements.

features.name: Document colors
features.description: A document's bgColor, fgColor, alinkColor, linkColor, and vlinkColor properties get and set the background, foreground, active link, link, and visited link colors of that document.

features.name: font-display
features.description: The font-display CSS descriptor sets whether to show a substitute font or nothing while a font face loads. The property manages what's known as a flash of unstyled text or flash of invisible text.

features.name: hardwareConcurrency
features.description: The navigator.hardwareConcurrency property is the number of logical processors available to run threads on the user's computer.

features.name: Spread syntax
features.description: The spread (...) syntax allows an iterable, such as an array or string, to be expanded in places where zero or more arguments (for function calls) or elements (for array literals) are expected.

features.name: Async generators
features.description: Async generator functions (async function*) create iterators that return multiple promises, one after another, on-demand.

features.name: Async iterators and the for await..of loop
features.description: Asynchronous iterator objects, such as those returned by promises or generator functions, are iterable with the for await .. of loop.

features.name: font-stretch
features.description: The font-stretch CSS property selects a font face from a font family based on width, either by a keyword such as condensed or a percentage.

features.name: Promise finally()
features.description: The promise finally() method executes a function when the promise settles (resolves or rejects).

features.name: <dialog>
features.description: The <dialog> HTML element represents a modal or non-modal dialog box, such as a confirmation prompt or a subwindow used to enter data.

features.name: Credential management
features.description: The navigator.credentials API provides generic storage for authentication credentials. Other credential APIs represent specific kinds of credentials, such as password or public key credentials, that the credential management API stores.

features.name: ImageBitmapRenderingContext
features.description: The ImageBitmapRenderingContext API is the "bitmaprenderer" rendering context for the <canvas> element. It is commonly used to transfer frames from an OffscreenCanvas to a user-visible <canvas> element.

features.name: Optional catch binding
features.description: Omit the binding parameter of a catch clause when you don't need information about the exception in a try ... catch statement.

features.name: Stable array sort
features.description: Stable array sort() function

features.name: Abortable fetch
features.description: If you construct a fetch request with an AbortSignal, you can cancel the request.

features.name: AbortController and AbortSignal
features.description: The AbortController and AbortSignal APIs allow you to cancel an ongoing operation, such as a fetch() request.

features.name: HSL
features.description: The hsl() and hsla() CSS functions pick colors using hue, saturation, lightness, and alpha (transparency) channels.

features.name: Intl.PluralRules
features.description: The Intl.PluralRules API creates a locale-aware object that tells you which of the language's pluralization rules apply based on a given number.

features.name: Print events
features.description: An alternative to @media print queries, the beforeprint and afterprint events allow you to change the page for printing and restore the page after printing.

features.name: RGB
features.description: The rgb(), rgba(), and hexadecimal (as in #004488ff) notations pick colors using red, green, blue, and alpha (transparency) channels.

features.name: Scroll snap
features.description: CSS scroll snap controls the panning and scrolling behavior within a scroll container.

features.name: String trimStart() and trimEnd()
features.description: The trimStart() and trimEnd() methods of strings return a new string with whitespace removed from the beginning or end of the string.

features.name: Array flat() and flatMap()
features.description: The flat() and flatMap() methods for arrays creates a new array such that each nested array item is concatenated into it.

features.name: Safe area inset environment variables
features.description: The safe-area-inset- CSS environment variables represent a rectangle that cannot cut off content within a non-rectangular screen. For example, top:\ env(safe-area-inset-top); positions the top of an element below the notch on an iPhone.

features.name: Visual viewport API
features.description: The visualViewport API provides a way to query and modify the user-visible viewport of a web page.

features.name: inputmode
features.description: The inputmode global HTML attribute gives a hint about what type of data is to be entered into an <input> element, such as text, numeric, or email, so the browser may help the user enter data using an adapted input mechanism, such as an on-screen virtual keyboard.

features.name: text-combine-upright
features.description: The text-combine-upright CSS property displays multiple characters in the space of a single character in vertical text. This is used in East Asian documents to display Latin-based strings such as components of a date or letters of an initialism.

features.name: PerformanceTiming and PerformanceNavigation
features.description: The window.performance.timing and window.performance.navigation APIs report performance timing information for events that occur during the loading and use of the current page.

features.name: Web authentication
features.description: The web authentication API allows you to create public key-based credentials and use them for authentication, such as when signing in. Also known as WebAuthn.

features.name: Conic gradients
features.description: The conic-gradient() and repeating-conic-gradient() CSS functions create backgrounds that progress between two or more colors around a center point.

features.name: contain
features.description: The contain CSS property sets limits to the scope of styles, layout, and paint rendering for speed and efficiency. The none keyword value disables containment, strict is equivalent to contain: size layout style paint, and content is equivalent to contain: layout style paint.

features.name: EXT_color_buffer_float WebGL extension
features.description: The EXT_color_buffer_float extension for WebGL 2.0 contexts adds color-renderable floating point formats to renderbufferStorage().

features.name: EXT_color_buffer_half_float WebGL extension
features.description: The EXT_color_buffer_half_float extension for WebGL 1.0 and 2.0 contexts renders 16-bit floating-point color buffers.

features.name: Layout containment
features.description: The contain: layout CSS declaration isolates the inside of an element such that it cannot affect the layout of the rest of the page or be affected by the rest of the page. This permits the browser to avoid slower layout calculations.

features.name: Paint containment
features.description: The contain: paint CSS declaration prevents an element's descendants from being drawn outside the boundaries of the containing element, with any overflow clipped. This permits the browser to avoid slower painting calculations.

features.name: Q unit
features.description: The Q CSS length unit is an absolute length anchored to the physical measurement of quarter-millimeters. 1Q is equivalent to 1/40 of 1 centimeter.

features.name: Scroll methods on elements
features.description: The scroll() and scrollBy() methods change the scroll position of overflow content within an element. Similar to setting scrollTop and scrollLeft properties, but with options setting whether the scroll should animate smoothly or jump. Note that scrollTo() is an alias for scroll().

features.name: Size containment
features.description: The contain: size CSS declaration sets an element's dimensions exclusively by its height and width properties, ignoring its contents and descendants. This permits the browser to avoid slower layout calculations.

features.name: WEBGL_compressed_texture_etc WebGL extension
features.description: The WEBGL_compressed_texture_etc extension for WebGL 1.0 and 2.0 contexts adds many ETC2 and EAC compressed texture formats to compressedTexImage2D() and compressedTexSubImage2D().

features.name: color-gamut media query
features.description: The color-gamut media query sets styles based on the colors a device can display.

features.name: IndexedDB
features.description: The IndexedDB API is a local storage transactional object database.

features.name: Resize observer
features.description: The ResizeObserver API observes and reacts to changes in the size of DOM elements.

features.name: WebGL2
features.description: The WebGL2RenderingContext API is the "webgl2" rendering context for the <canvas> element. It represents a space for drawing two- and three-dimensional graphics and animations. It corresponds to OpenGL ES 3.0.

features.name: BroadcastChannel
features.description: The BroadcastChannel API allows you to send messages between same-origin browsing contexts, such as between the same page loaded in multiple tabs.

features.name: Navigation timing performance entries
features.description: A navigation performance entry measures navigation events, such as loading time or the number of redirects.

features.name: Style containment
features.description: The contain: style CSS declaration permits the browser to avoid slower layout calculations by preventing modification to counter (counter-increment and counter-set) and quotation styles (content property quote values) beyond the element's descendants.

features.name: WEBGL_color_buffer_float WebGL extension
features.description: The WEBGL_color_buffer_float extension for WebGL 1.0 contexts adds the 32-bit floating-point type RGBA32F as a color-renderable format.

features.name: BigInt
features.description: The BigInt JavaScript type represents integers of any size, including integers too large for the primitive Number type.

features.name: overflow
features.description: The overflow CSS property sets the behavior for when content doesn't fit in an element.

features.name: Paint timing performance entries
features.description: A paint performance entry measures the duration of "paint" (also called "render") operations as a page loads. It measures the time to First Paint (FP) and First Contentful Paint (FCP), common metrics for perceived loading times.

features.name: <input type="color">
features.description: The <input type="color"> HTML element shows a color picker from which users can choose a color value.

features.name: prefers-reduced-motion media query
features.description: The prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query sets styles based on whether the user prefers to minimize the amount of non-essential animations on the device, such as scrolling, panning, zooming, and strobing.

features.name: AudioWorklet
features.description: The AudioWorklet API runs module code in a separate thread, specifically for non-blocking, low latency audio processing.

features.name: BigInt64Array
features.description: The BigInt64Array and BigUint64Array typed arrays represent 64-bit integers, signed and unsigned respectively.

features.name: scroll-behavior
features.description: The scroll-behavior CSS property controls whether scrolling is smooth or snaps, for scroll actions not performed by the user such as those triggered by navigation.

features.name: Sign extension operators (WebAssembly)
features.description: Sign-extension operator instructions extend the width of 8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit values to 32-bit and 64-bit values.

features.name: globalThis
features.description: The globalThis property accesses the global this value (and hence the global object itself) across environments.

features.name: queueMicrotask()
features.description: The queueMicrotask() method schedules a function to run after the currently running synchronous JavaScript finishes but before returning to the event loop.

features.name: Streams
features.description: The streams API creates, composes, and consumes continuously generated data.

features.name: String matchAll()
features.description: The matchAll() method of strings matches a string against a regular expression and returns an iterator of all results, including capturing groups.

features.name: text-decoration-skip-ink
features.description: The text-decoration-skip-ink CSS property sets whether underlines and overlines may be interrupted where the line would cross a glyph.

features.name: EXT_frag_depth WebGL extension
features.description: The EXT_frag_depth extension for WebGL 1.0 and 2.0 contexts adds setting the depth value of a fragment from within the fragment shader.

features.name: Locks
features.description: The navigator.locks API coordinates work with shared resources through mutually exclusive ownership of a resource's name. Also known as web locks.

features.name: Intl.RelativeTimeFormat
features.description: The Intl.RelativeTimeFormat API creates a locale-aware formatter that turns an object representing a relative time (such as '1 day ago') into a localized string.

features.name: Numeric separators
features.description: To improve readability for numeric literals, underscores (_) can be used as separators. For example, 1_050.95 is equivalent to 1050.95.

features.name: Hashbang comments
features.description: The #! comment at the absolute start of a script or module is treated as a normal comment and is ignored by the JavaScript engine.

features.name: Import and export of mutable globals (WebAssembly)
features.description: Mutable global variables are importable and exportable.

features.name: prefers-color-scheme media query
features.description: The prefers-color-scheme CSS media query sets styles based on the requested color scheme, light or dark.

features.name: Promise.allSettled()
features.description: The Promise.allSettled() static method waits for an array of promises to settle (resolve or reject).

features.name: Shadow parts
features.description: The part and exportparts HTML attributes expose elements of a shadow DOM as named parts, which can be selected by the ::part() CSS pseudo-element for styling.

features.name: Intl.Locale
features.description: The Intl.Locale API parses Unicode locale identifiers, with language, region, and script codes, such as zh-Hans-CN or en-GB.

features.name: Intl.ListFormat
features.description: The Intl.ListFormat API creates a locale-aware formatter that turns iterable objects into localized strings.

features.name: Permissions
features.description: The navigator.permissions API checks whether a permission, such as access to geolocation data, has been granted.

features.name: Notifications from service workers and installed apps
features.description: Notifications via service worker registration's showNotification() method, sent from installed web applications (for example, saved to the Home Screen on Safari for iOS), show a message to the user, typically using the notification system of the host operating system.

features.name: text-align-last
features.description: The text-align-last CSS property sets the alignment of the last line of text before a forced line break.

features.name: enterkeyhint
features.description: The enterkeyhint global HTML attribute sets the label for a virtual keyboard's Enter key. For example, enterkeyhint="search" may label the key with a magnifying glass icon.

features.name: steps() easing
features.description: The steps() CSS easing function divides an animation or transition into equidistant intervals, jumping from value to value. The step-start and step-end keyword values are presets with a single interval.

features.name: Media playback quality
features.description: The getVideoPlaybackQuality() method of HTMLVideoElement returns metrics that can be used to determine the playback quality of a video, such as how many frames were dropped.

features.name: Non-trapping float-to-int conversion (WebAssembly)
features.description: Saturating floating-point to integer conversion operators return the maximum or minimum integer value on overflow instead of trapping.

features.name: Bulk memory operations (WebAssembly)
features.description: Bulk memory operations, such as copy and init, mirror the efficiency of native memcpy and memmove operations.

features.name: Motion path
features.description: The offset CSS property animates an element along a defined motion path.

features.name: font-optical-sizing
features.description: The font-optical-sizing CSS property sets whether text rendering is optimized for viewing at different sizes.

features.name: min(), max(), and clamp()
features.description: The min() and max() CSS functions return the minimum or maximum of the arguments, while clamp() clamps a value to a given range.

features.name: Screen orientation
features.description: The screen.orientation API gets information about the orientation of the viewport, such as landscape or portrait. With this API, you can adapt an application's layout or behavior in response to changes in orientation.

features.name: WEBGL_compressed_texture_s3tc_srgb WebGL extension
features.description: The WEBGL_compressed_texture_s3tc_srgb extension for WebGL 1.0 and 2.0 contexts adds S3TC compressed texture formats for the sRGB colorspace to compressedTexImage2D() and compressedTexSubImage2D().

features.name: Opacity (SVG)
features.description: The fill-opacity, and stroke-opacity SVG attributes and CSS properties control the transparency of a stroke or fill of an SVG element.

features.name: Push messages
features.description: The Push API subscribes to and receives server-initiated messages. Subscribers receive pushed messages in the background, even after periods inactive or offline.

features.name: image-orientation
features.description: The image-orientation CSS property corrects the rotation of an image using the image's metadata, such as EXIF.

features.name: line-break
features.description: The line-break CSS property sets how strictly to apply rules for wrapping text to new lines, especially for symbols and punctuation.

features.name: resolution media query
features.description: The resolution CSS media query sets styles based on the pixel density, or how many pixels a device uses to display a single CSS pixel.

features.name: OES_fbo_render_mipmap WebGL extension
features.description: The OES_fbo_render_mipmap extension for WebGL 1.0 contexts attaches any level of a texture to a framebuffer object.

features.name: <datalist>
features.description: The <datalist> element sets recommended values for an <input> element. Browsers may show a dropdown menu of all values or match values as the user types.

features.name: zoom
features.description: The zoom CSS property scales the size of an element. Unlike the transform property, a zoomed element affects page layout.

features.name: Media session
features.description: The navigator.mediaSession API integrates with platform UI for media playback. It can be used to set metadata such as title and artwork, and to handle user actions like playing, pausing, or seeking.

features.name: Resource size
features.description: The decodedBodySize, encodedBodySize, and transferSize properties of the PerformanceResourceTiming API reports the size of resources loaded.

features.name: Intl.DisplayNames
features.description: The Intl.DisplayNames API provides localized names of language, region, script, and currency codes.

features.name: WebRTC SCTP information
features.description: The sctp object on RTCPeerConnection represents the negotiated SCTP transport. SCTP (Stream Control Transmission Protocol) is the protocol that RTCDataChannel uses.

features.name: messageerror
features.description: The messageerror event fires on a target, such as a window or worker, when an incoming message cannot be deserialized. This event can fire for many types of messages, such as cross-document messages or broadcast channel messages.

features.name: SharedArrayBuffer and Atomics
features.description: The SharedArrayBuffer object represents bytes shared between multiple workers and the main thread. The Atomics object safely accesses SharedArrayBuffer data to make sure predictable values are read and written and that operations are not interrupted.

features.name: revert
features.description: The revert CSS keyword resets any property to its previous default, provided by either the user or browser stylesheets. For example, setting display: revert on a <div> will likely result in display: block, the browser default style. This is often confused with initial.

features.name: Server timing
features.description: The serverTiming property of a resource performance entry contains server timing information about network requests.

features.name: contenteditable="plaintext-only"
features.description: The contenteditable="plaintext-only" global HTML attribute allows the user to edit the content of an element, but prevents rich-text formatting.

features.name: JavaScript modules in workers
features.description: The Worker() constructor accepts { type: "module" } to load scripts that use import and export. Also known as ECMAScript modules or ESM in workers.

features.name: Offscreen canvas
features.description: The OffscreenCanvas API provides a canvas that can be drawn to off screen, with no dependencies on the DOM, which can be used to run heavy rendering operations inside a worker context.

features.name: requestAnimationFrame() in workers
features.description: The requestAnimationFrame() method in workers schedules a function that runs before the next repaint. Together with offscreen canvas, you can animate content from a worker.

features.name: Threads and atomics (WebAssembly)
features.description: Threads in WebAssembly run code in parallel, while atomic memory instructions can guarantee that no two threads can read or write to shared memory at the same time.

features.name: text-underline-offset
features.description: The text-underline-offset CSS property shifts underlines on text from the initial position by a given distance. The initial position is affected by the text-underline-position property.

features.name: String replaceAll()
features.description: The replaceAll() method of strings returns a new string where all matches of a pattern (a string or regular expression) have been substituted with a replacement string.

features.name: Web animations
features.description: The web animation API programmatically creates, inspects, and controls element animations, to change and synchronize appearance over time.

features.name: baseline-shift
features.description: The baseline-shift CSS property sets the position of an element relative to its dominant baseline.

features.name: Logical assignments
features.description: The logical AND assignment (&&=) and the logical OR assignment (||=) operators short-circuit the respective binary logical operators.

features.name: Nullish coalescing
features.description: The nullish coalescing (??) and nullish coalescing assignment (??=) operators return (or assign) its right-hand side operand when its left-hand side operand is null or undefined, and otherwise returns its left-hand side operand.

features.name: Promise.any()
features.description: The Promise.any() static method returns a promise that fulfills as soon as the first of an iterable of promises fulfills, with that promise's value. Otherwise, it rejects with an AggregateError when all of the promises have rejected.

features.name: Constructed stylesheets
features.description: The CSSStyleSheet constructor creates a new stylesheet which can be shared between a document and multiple shadow roots using adoptedStyleSheets.

features.name: Flexbox gap
features.description: The gap CSS property in a flexbox layout sets the size of the space between items.

features.name: Multi-value (WebAssembly)
features.description: Instructions and blocks can produce multiple result values.

features.name: Weak references
features.description: The WeakRef and FinalizationRegistry objects hold references to garbage-collectable objects without creating strong references that prevent their garbage collection.

features.name: BigInt to i64 conversion (WebAssembly)
features.description: Integer values pass bidirectionally between JavaScript and WebAssembly, converted to i64 values in WebAssembly or BigInt values in JavaScript.

features.name: Referrer policy
features.description: The Referrer-Policy HTTP header and referrerpolicy HTML attributes control whether requests have the Referer header and what information the header contains.

features.name: appearance
features.description: The appearance CSS property controls the appearance of form controls. Using appearance: none disables any default native appearance and allows the elements to be styled with CSS.

features.name: :not()
features.description: The :not() functional pseudo-class matches elements that do not match the selectors in its argument.

features.name: Form-associated custom elements
features.description: Custom elements may act like built-in form elements, via the attachInternals() method of HTMLElement and the ElementInternals API.

features.name: Quotes
features.description: The quotes CSS property sets the quotation marks inserted via the content CSS property or <q> element.

features.name: :focus-visible
features.description: The :focus-visible CSS pseudo-class selects elements that match the :focus pseudo-class and meets the browser's criteria for visually emphasizing focused elements.

features.name: User activation
features.description: The navigator.userActivation API reveals whether the user has interacted with the page through an "activation" gesture such as a click, tap, or key press. User activation gated APIs (such as the fullscreen API) fail without user interaction, and this API allows you to predict such a failure.

features.name: clip-path
features.description: The clip-path CSS property and SVG attribute set the visible area of an element. Everything outside the area will be hidden.

features.name: :is()
features.description: The :is() CSS functional pseudo-class takes a selector list as its argument, and matches any element that can be selected by one of the selectors in that list.

features.name: :where()
features.description: The :where() CSS functional pseudo-class takes a selector list as its argument, and matches any element that can be selected by one of the selectors in that list. It is functionally equivalent to the selectors in the list, but doesn't affect the CSS rule specificity.

features.name: ::file-selector-button
features.description: The ::file-selector-button CSS pseudo-element selects the button of a <input type="file"> element.

features.name: aspect-ratio
features.description: The aspect-ratio CSS property controls the width-to-height ratio of elements. For and

features.name: Logical properties
features.description: CSS logical properties control borders, size, margin, and padding with directions and dimensions relative to the writing mode. For example, in a left to right, top to bottom writing mode, block-end refers to the bottom. Also known as flow relative.

features.name: Storage manager
features.description: The navigator.storage API provides information about the availability and persistence of the data that a site stores on the device, by using APIs such as the Cache API or the IndexedDB API.

features.name: Compression streams
features.description: The CompressionStream and DecompressionStream APIs compress and decompress data using the gzip or deflate formats.

features.name: Async clipboard
features.description: The navigator.clipboard API asynchronously reads and writes to the system clipboard.

features.name: createImageBitmap
features.description: The createImageBitmap() global method creates an ImageBitmap object from a source such as an image, SVG, blob, or canvas. An ImageBitmap object represents pixel data that can be drawn to a canvas with lower latency than other types, such as ImageData.

features.name: Lazy-loading images and iframes
features.description: The loading="lazy" attribute for and

features.name: <link rel="modulepreload">
features.description: The rel="modulepreload" attribute for the <link> HTML element indicates that a module script should be fetched, parsed, and compiled preemptively, and stored for later execution.

features.name: Web authentication easy public key access
features.description: The getAuthenticatorData(), getPublicKey(), and getPublicKeyAlgorithm() methods of AuthenticatorAttestationResponse access credential data inside attestationObject without the need to parse it.

features.name: Preloading responsive images
features.description: The imagesrcset and imagesizes attributes with the rel="preload" attribute for the <link> HTML element starts fetching responsive images before they're found in the body of the document.

features.name: font-synthesis
features.description: The font-synthesis CSS shorthand property disables all font synthesis except the given kinds. To disable a specific kind of font synthesis, instead use the longhand properties such as font-synthesis-style and font-synthesis-weight.

features.name: Forced colors
features.description: The forced-colors CSS @media rule detects when a user has chosen to use a forced colors mode, also known as high-contrast mode, and the forced-color-adjust CSS property sets whether forced colors apply to an element.

features.name: Array at()
features.description: The at() method of arrays and typed arrays returns the item at an index, including negative indices for getting items relative to the end of an array. Also known as the relative indexing method.

features.name: String at()
features.description: The at() method of strings returns the character (one UTF-16 code unit) at an index, including negative indices for getting the character relative to the end of the string. Also known as the relative indexing method.

features.name: Error cause
features.description: The cause property of errors records the specific original cause of the error, particularly for errors that have been re-thrown.

features.name: overflow: clip
features.description: The overflow: clip CSS declaration clips an element's overflowing content to the box that's defined by the overflow-clip-margin property. Unlike overflow: hidden, it allows you to hide overflow on one axis while keeping overflow on the other axis visible.

features.name: requestVideoFrameCallback()
features.description: The requestVideoFrameCallback() method for <video> schedules a function that runs with the next video frame. It is similar to requestAnimationFrame(), but for video.

features.name: Object.hasOwn()
features.description: The Object.hasOwn() static method checks whether an object has a given property. It's a more robust alternative to the Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty() method.

features.name: cookieEnabled
features.description: The navigator.cookieEnabled property is a boolean for whether the browser accepts or ignores attempts to write cookie data.

features.name: contain-intrinsic-size
features.description: The contain-intrinsic-size CSS property sets the intrinsic size of an element. When using size containment, the browser will lay out the element as if it had a single child of this size.

features.name: Hyphenation
features.description: The hyphens CSS property controls when long words are broken by line wrapping. Although called hyphens, the property applies to word-splitting behavior across languages, such as customary spelling changes or the use of other characters. Support for non-English languages varies significantly.

features.name: Import maps
features.description: A <script type="importmap"> HTML element provides an import map as a JSON string. An import map controls how the browser should resolve module specifiers when importing JavaScript modules.

features.name: prefers-contrast media query
features.description: The prefers-contrast CSS media query sets styles based on whether the user prefers more or less contrast, the difference between foreground and background colors.

features.name: Exception handling (WebAssembly)
features.description: Exceptions break the normal control flow of execution to represent exceptional behavior, such as an error. You can respond to the exception in JavaScript code.

features.name: Reference types (WebAssembly)
features.description: The externref type can be both a value type and a table element type, while funcref can be a value type.

features.name: Array findLast() and findLastIndex()
features.description: The findLast() and findLastIndex() methods of arrays and typed arrays search an array in reverse order for the first item that satisfies a test function.

features.name: Intl.Segmenter
features.description: The Intl.Segmenter API creates a locale-aware text splitter that can separate a string into meaningful graphemes, words, or sentences.

features.name: Scroll to text fragment
features.description: Text fragments are URL fragments on the form #:~:text=snippet and link to a snippet of text within a page. The browser may scroll, highlight, or otherwise bring that text to the reader's attention.

features.name: Fixed-width SIMD (WebAssembly)
features.description: 128-bit SIMD (Single Instruction Multiple Data) performs one instruction on multiple units of data, when running on hardware that supports such instructions. Also known as vector instructions.

features.name: Page setup
features.description: The @page CSS at-rule sets the page-specific dimensions and margins for content such as printed documents, ebooks, or slides.

features.name: AVIF
features.description: AVIF (AV1 Image File Format) is an image format based on the AV1 video format.

features.name: counter-set
features.description: The counter-set CSS property creates (and optionally sets a value for) a counter, the numbers for a series of headings or ordered list items.

features.name: Imperative slot assignment
features.description: The assign() method for <slot> elements assigns nodes to the slot, as an alternative to using the slot and name HTML attributes. The nodes must be children of a shadow host and the shadow root must be created with the slotAssignment set to "manual". Also known as manual slot assignment.

features.name: preservesPitch
features.description: The preservesPitch property for <audio> or <video> adjusts the pitch of audio to sound more natural when the playback rate is faster or slower than the default.

features.name: text-emphasis
features.description: The text-emphasis CSS property sets position and style for text emphasis marks, especially for East Asian languages.

features.name: outline
features.description: The outline CSS shorthand sets the color, style, and width of a line around an element, outside of the border.

features.name: pdfViewerEnabled
features.description: The navigator.pdfViewerEnabled property is a boolean for whether the browser navigates to and shows a PDF in the browser window or downloads the PDF.

features.name: backdrop-filter
features.description: The backdrop-filter CSS property applies graphical effects such as blurring or color shifting to the area behind an element.

features.name: EXT_texture_compression_bptc WebGL extension
features.description: The EXT_texture_compression_bptc extension for WebGL 1.0 and 2.0 contexts adds the BPTC compressed texture formats to compressedTexImage2D() and compressedTexSubImage2D().

features.name: color-scheme
features.description: The color-scheme CSS property sets which color schemes (light or dark) an element uses and may prevent automatic dark mode adjustments by the browser.

features.name: Touch events
features.description: Touch events touchstart, touchmove, touchend, and touchcancel fire when users interact with a touch-sensitive surface, such as a screen or drawing tablet. These events are similar to mouse events.

features.name: dynamic-range media query
features.description: The dynamic-range CSS media query sets styles based on whether a device can display at least standard range colors or at least high range colors. Non-visual devices will match neither.

features.name: Registered custom properties
features.description: The CSS.registerProperty() static method and the @property CSS at-rule register custom properties for which types and behaviors can be defined.

features.name: structuredClone()
features.description: The structuredClone() global method creates a deep copy of an object. Values that cannot be cloned can instead be transferred, making the original value no longer usable.

features.name: @counter-style
features.description: The @counter-style CSS at-rule sets custom counter styles for list items. For example, you can use a sequence of specific symbols instead of numbers for an ordered list.

features.name: Cascade layers
features.description: The @layer CSS at-rule avoids specificity conflicts by providing priority levels for different groups of CSS rules, such as low-priority styles like resets, and high-priority styles like UI components.

features.name: font-synthesis-small-caps
features.description: The font-synthesis-small-caps CSS property sets whether or not the browser should synthesize small caps typefaces when they're missing from the font.

features.name: font-synthesis-style
features.description: The font-synthesis-style CSS property sets whether or not the browser should synthesize italic and oblique typefaces when they're missing from the font.

features.name: font-synthesis-weight
features.description: The font-synthesis-weight CSS property sets whether or not the browser should synthesize bold typefaces when they're missing from the font.

features.name: Alt text for generated content
features.description: The / notation in content CSS property values adds alternative text to generated content. For example, the content: url('upvote-icon.svg') / 'Upvote' declaration adds accessible 'Upvote' text to the SVG icon. Also known as alternate text.

features.name: JavaScript modules in service workers
features.description: The navigator.serviceWorker.register() method accepts { type: "module" } to load scripts that use import and export. Also known as ECMAScript modules or ESM in service workers.

features.name: Widows and orphans
features.description: The widows and orphans CSS properties set the minimum lines included in a text fragment created by page, column, or region breaks.

features.name: alignment-baseline
features.description: The alignment-baseline CSS property sets which baseline of an element is aligned with the corresponding baseline of its parent.

features.name: Page selectors
features.description: The :first, :left, and :right pseudo-classes select pages based on their position in sequence after pagination.

features.name: ping
features.description: The ping attribute for <a> elements sets a URL to send a POST request to when the <a> is clicked. This is typically used for outbound link reporting.

features.name: Time-relative pseudo-selectors
features.description: The :past and :future CSS pseudo-classes match prior or upcoming text track cues during media playback.

features.name: HTTP/3
features.description: HTTP/3 is a major revision of the HTTP network protocol, providing improved performance and efficiency by using QUIC as the underlying transport protocol.

features.name: autocapitalize
features.description: The autocapitalize global HTML attribute sets the virtual keyboard capitalization behavior for user input on an element, such as the first letter of sentences or all words.

features.name: ruby-position
features.description: The ruby-position CSS property sets the position of a ruby annotation in relation to its base text. Annotations can display over, under, or interleaved with the base text.

features.name: Payment request
features.description: The PaymentRequest API prompts the user to make a payment through the browser's user interface.

features.name: Web app manifest
features.description: A web app manifest file provides metadata about the site. The browser can use the metadata to install the site as a standalone application on the user's device. The metadata usually includes the app's name, icon, description, and ways in which the app wishes to integrate with the device.

features.name: Atomics.waitAsync()
features.description: The Atomics.waitAsync() static method waits for a value in a shared memory location, providing a promise when the expected value is not yet in memory. The waitAsync() method is a non-blocking alternative to Atomics.wait().

features.name: HWB
features.description: The hwb() CSS function picks colors using hue, whiteness, and blackness channels.

features.name: AudioListener
features.description: An AudioListener object represents the virtual position and orientation of a person relative to sound sources, to spatialize audio in a Web Audio context.

features.name: Media capabilities
features.description: The navigator.mediaCapabilities API queries the encoding and decoding abilities of the device, such as supported codecs, resolutions, and bitrates.

features.name: font-palette
features.description: The font-palette CSS property selects a color palette from the font, optionally overriding individual colors in the @font-palette-values at-rule.

features.name: OES_draw_buffers_indexed WebGL extension
features.description: The OES_draw_buffers_indexed extension for WebGL 2.0 contexts allows you to control blending on a per-color basis when writing to multiple color buffers simultaneously.

features.name: Canvas createConicGradient()
features.description: The createConicGradient() methods draw a conic gradient to a 2D canvas.

features.name: Canvas roundRect()
features.description: The roundRect() methods draw a rounded rectangle to a 2D canvas.

features.name: EXT_texture_compression_rgtc WebGL extension
features.description: The EXT_texture_compression_rgtc extension for WebGL 1.0 and 2.0 contexts adds RGTC compressed texture formats. RGTC is a block-based texture compression format suited for unsigned and signed red and red-green textures. Also known as Red-Green Texture Compression.

features.name: KHR_parallel_shader_compile WebGL extension
features.description: The KHR_parallel_shader_compile extension for WebGL 1.0 and 2.0 contexts checks the status of shader compilation without blocking the runtime.

features.name: Desynchronized 2D canvas
features.description: The optional desynchronized parameter of a canvas's getContext() method permits the browser to draw a 2D canvas independently of the event loop. This can reduce drawing latency.

features.name: Reporting API
features.description: The Reporting-Endpoints HTTP header and ReportingObserver() API send selected reports, such as Content Security Policy (CSP) violation reports or crash reports, to a nominated URL or callback function.

features.name: scrollbar-gutter
features.description: The scrollbar-gutter CSS property reserves space for the scrollbar, preventing unwanted layout changes as the scrollbar appears and disappears.

features.name: inert
features.description: The inert HTML attribute marks an element and its descendants as non-interactive. Inert elements don't get focus or fire click events.

features.name: CSS typed object model
features.description: The CSSStyleValue and its subclasses represent CSS values as distinct types instead of only strings. Also known as typed OM.

features.name: Numeric factory functions
features.description: The numeric factory functions, such as CSS.px() or CSS.kHz(), return a CSSUnitValue representing a CSS number value (as in 12px or 440kHz).

features.name: Picture-in-picture (video)
features.description: The picture-in-picture API allow websites to create a floating, always-on-top video window. Also known as PiP or pop-out video.

features.name: Canvas reset()
features.description: The reset() method clears a canvas to its initial state.

features.name: Individual transform properties
features.description: The translate, rotate, and scale CSS properties apply single transformations independently, as opposed to applying multiple transformations with the transform CSS property.

features.name: Screen wake lock
features.description: The navigator.wakeLock.request("screen") API prevents the device's screen from dimming or being turned off.

features.name: WEBGL_multi_draw WebGL extension
features.description: The WEBGL_multi_draw extension for WebGL 1.0 and 2.0 contexts renders more than one primitive with a single function call.

features.name: CSP violation reports
features.description: CSP violation reporting sends a report to a URL nominated by the Reporting-Endpoints header or the ReportingObserver API when a page violates its content security policy.

features.name: ::target-text
features.description: The ::target-text pseudo-element allows you to style text highlighted by a URL text fragment such as #:~:text=snippet.

features.name: ARIA attribute reflection
features.description: WAI-ARIA attributes have corresponding properties on Element and ElementInternals objects.

features.name: willReadFrequently
features.description: The optional willReadFrequently parameter of a canvas's getContext() method permits the browser to optimize for frequent getImageData() calls by avoiding hardware acceleration. Also known as multiple readback.

features.name: :modal
features.description: The :modal pseudo-class selects elements that put other elements into a non-interactive state, such as a fullscreen element or a <dialog> element used with showModal().

features.name: EXT_texture_norm16 WebGL extension
features.description: The EXT_texture_norm16 extension to WebGL 2.0 contexts adds 16 bit signed normalized and unsigned normalized fixed-point texture, renderbuffer, and texture buffer formats.

features.name: Media query range syntax
features.description: The range syntax of CSS media queries allows you to use mathematical comparison operators such as <, >, <=, and >= to define a range of values for a media query. For example, (400px < width < 1000px) returns true if the viewport width is between 400px and 1000px.

features.name: Inline-size containment
features.description: The contain: inline-size CSS declaration prevents the element's inline dimension from being set by the element's contents. This permits the browser to avoid slower layout calculations.

features.name: Color management for 2D canvas
features.description: The optional colorSpace parameter of a 2D canvas's getContext() method chooses the color representation, such as "srgb" or "display-p3".

features.name: ic unit
features.description: The ic CSS length unit corresponds to the width of CJK ideographic characters.

features.name: :has()
features.description: The :has() CSS functional pseudo-class matches an element if any of the selectors passed as parameters would match at least one element.

features.name: Container queries (size)
features.description: Container size queries with the @container (…) at-rule apply styles to an element based on a dimension of its container, such as width or height.

features.name: <link rel="dns-prefetch">
features.description: The rel="dns-prefetch" attribute for the <link> HTML element is a hint to the browser that the page or user is likely to request resources from another domain, so the browser should preemptively resolve DNS for the href value's domain.

features.name: <input type="month">
features.description: The <input type="month"> HTML element shows a month picker.

features.name: Grid animation
features.description: Grid animation allows you to animate the grid-template-columns and grid-template-rows CSS properties.

features.name: Small, large, and dynamic viewport units
features.description: The sv*, lv*, and dv* CSS viewport units are relative to the smallest, largest, and current (dynamic) viewport size. They are used to size elements in relation to the viewport's dimensions.

features.name: COEP violation reports
features.description: COEP violation reporting sends a report to a URL nominated by the Reporting-Endpoints header or the ReportingObserver API when a page violates its Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy policy.

features.name: MathML
features.description: MathML, or the Mathematical Markup Language, describes mathematical notation, such as expressions and formulas. Also known as MathML Core.

features.name: Color management for WebGL
features.description: The drawingBufferColorSpace and unpackColorSpace properties of WebGLRenderingContext sets the color representation for the buffer and imported textures, such as "srgb" or "display-p3".

features.name: Color management for WebGL2
features.description: The drawingBufferColorSpace and unpackColorSpace properties of WebGL2RenderingContext sets the color representation for the buffer and imported textures, such as "srgb" or "display-p3".

features.name: checkVisibility()
features.description: The checkVisibility() method checks if an element is potentially visible, with optional parameters for the kinds of visibility to check. For example, it checks whether the element has the style display: none, but can also check for visibility: hidden.

features.name: Fetch priority
features.description: The fetch() priority option and the fetchpriority HTML attribute give hints to the browser about which requests to do before other requests of the same type.

features.name: Hyphenate character
features.description: The hyphenate-character CSS property sets the character or string to use at the end of a line before a line break.

features.name: Event timing performance entries
features.description: An event or first-input performance entry measures the latency of user input events, such as mouse clicks or keypresses. They're used to calculate interaction to next paint (INP), a common metric for perceived responsiveness.

features.name: Origin private file system
features.description: The navigator.storage.getDirectory() method returns a FileSystemDirectoryHandle that is restricted to a specific origin and invisible to the user's actual file system for faster file-based applications, such as SQLite databases.

features.name: lh unit
features.description: The lh CSS length unit corresponds to the requested line height, the computed value of the line-height property. Some lines may be higher than this based on their content.

features.name: Custom highlights
features.description: Custom highlights style arbitrary text ranges, without adding extra elements to the DOM.

features.name: font-variant-alternates
features.description: The font-variant-alternates CSS property, along with the @font-feature-values at-rule, chooses when to use a font's alternate glyphs.

features.name: Largest contentful paint (LCP) performance entries
features.description: A largest-contentful-paint performance entry measures the time it takes for the largest image or text to appear. Largest contentful paint (LCP) is a common metric for perceived loading times.

features.name: <input type="file" webkitdirectory>
features.description: The <input type="file" webkitdirectory> HTML element shows a file picker from which users can choose a folder to upload with the form.

features.name: :nth-child() of <selector>
features.description: The of syntax for the :nth-child() and :nth-last-child() CSS functional pseudo-classes match elements by the relative position of elements, counted from the first or last sibling matching a selector list.

features.name: <input type="week">
features.description: The <input type="week"> HTML element shows a week picker.

features.name: Trusted types
features.description: Trusted types allow you to lock down insecure parts of the DOM API and prevent client-side cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks.

features.name: Trigonometric functions (CSS)
features.description: The sin(), cos(), tan(), asin(), acos(), atan(), and atan2() CSS functions compute various trigonometric functions.

features.name: color()
features.description: The color() function picks a color from a given color space. Wide gamut color spaces like display-p3 allow showing more vibrant and saturated colors than the standard srgb color space.

features.name: Lab and LCH
features.description: The CIE Lab color space expresses colors in terms of lightness and how red/green and blue/yellow a color is. LCH is a variant of Lab with polar coordinates. These color spaces can be used with the CSS color(), lab(), and lch() functions. Also known as CIELAB and CIELCH.

features.name: Array by copy
features.description: The toReversed(), toSorted(), toSpliced(), and with() methods of arrays and typed arrays return changed copies of arrays. They stand in contrast to methods such as sort() or reverse() that change arrays in place.

features.name: calc() keywords
features.description: The e, pi, infinity, and NaN keywords represent well-defined constants accepted in CSS math functions such as calc().

features.name: Oklab and OkLCh
features.description: The Oklab color space expresses colors in terms of lightness and how red/green and blue/yellow a color is, aiming to match how humans perceive colors. OkLCh is a variant of Oklab with polar coordinates. These color spaces can be used with the CSS oklab() and oklch() functions.

features.name: Readable byte streams
features.description: A ReadableStream constructed with { type: "bytes" } reads bytes from a stream without making extra copies, improving efficiency for streams of large chunks. Also known as BYOB or bring your own buffer.

features.name: color-mix()
features.description: The color-mix() function mixes two colors in a given color space and by a given amount. Commonly, lighter or darker variations of a color are created by mixing with white or black.

features.name: rlh unit
features.description: The rlh CSS length unit is a font-relative length relative to the line height of root element.

features.name: String isWellFormed() and toWellFormed()
features.description: The isWellFormed() method of strings returns a boolean indicating if the string contains any Unicode lone surrogates. The toWellFormed() method returns a new string where all lone surrogates are replaced by the Unicode replacement character.

features.name: overflow: overlay
features.description: The overflow: overlay CSS declaration is an alias to overflow: auto. Historically, it caused non-standard behavior, allowing scrollbars to overlay content without taking up layout space.

features.name: animation-composition
features.description: The animation-composition CSS property chooses how to combine animations that affect the same property.

features.name: URLPattern
features.description: The URLPattern API creates patterns that can be matched against URLs or URL components.

features.name: WebCodecs
features.description: The WebCodecs API provides low-level access to individual video frames and chunks of audio samples, for full control over the way media is processed.

features.name: Two-value display property
features.description: The display CSS property accepts multiple keyword values, such as inline flex or block flow, to explicitly set an element's inner and outer layout mode. Also known as 2-value, multi-keyword, or multiple value syntax.

features.name: WebTransport
features.description: The WebTransport API transmits data between a client and a server, by using the HTTP/3 protocol.

features.name: Gradient interpolation
features.description: Gradient interpolation controls how the colors between gradient stops are calculated in CSS. For example, linear-gradient(to right in oklch longer hue, red, red); calculates in the oklch color space, with the hue going all the way around the hue circle from red back to red.

features.name: Declarative shadow DOM
features.description: The shadowrootmode attribute on <template> creates a shadow root without the use of JavaScript. It is a declarative alternative to the attachShadow() method.

features.name: Resizable buffers
features.description: The resize() method of an ArrayBuffer and the grow() method of a SharedArrayBuffer, constructed with the maxByteLength option, changes the size of the buffer in place.

features.name: Overflow media queries
features.description: The overflow-block and overflow-inline CSS media queries set styles based on the way a device displays content that's larger than the viewport or page area. For example, a laptop lets users scroll to reveal content, while a printer displays overflowing content on additional pages.

features.name: image-set()
features.description: The image-set() CSS function provides a set of images at different resolutions or pixel densities, which the browser can pick from, depending on the device capabilities.

features.name: Update frequency media query
features.description: The update CSS media query sets styles based on whether and how fast the user's device can modify display after it has been rendered. For example, you can avoid animations on devices that aren't fast enough to display them smoothly.

features.name: linear() easing
features.description: The linear() easing function for animations and transitions interpolates linearly between the control points, and can be used to approximate complex easing functions, such as a bounce effect.

features.name: Extended constant expressions (WebAssembly)
features.description: The i32.add, i32.sub, i32.mul, i64.add, i64.sub, and i64.mul operations extend constant expressions to include arithmetic.

features.name: rch unit
features.description: The rch CSS length unit is a font-relative length equal to the value of the ch unit on the root element. ch length is based on the width of the zero (0) character.

features.name: rex unit
features.description: The rex CSS length unit is a font-relative length that is equal to the x-height of the root element.

features.name: ric unit
features.description: The ric CSS length unit, or root international character, is a font-relative length equal to the width of CJK character relative to the root element.

features.name: blocking="render"
features.description: The blocking="render" attribute for <link>, <script>, and <style> elements blocks rendering until the external script or stylesheet has been loaded. For <link rel="expect">, rendering is blocked until a specific element is in the DOM.

features.name: text-wrap: balance
features.description: The text-wrap: balance CSS declaration balances the length of each line when text is broken into multiple lines. Also known as headline balancing.

features.name: Subgrid
features.description: The subgrid value for the grid-template-columns and grid-template-rows properties allows a grid item to inherit the grid definition of its parent grid container.

features.name: :autofill
features.description: The :autofill pseudo-class matches <input> elements that have been filled in automatically by the browser.

features.name: Tail call optimization (WebAssembly)
features.description: Tail call optimization discards a caller frame and replaces the call with a jump instruction.

features.name: Storage access
features.description: The document.requestStorageAccess() method allows content in iframes to request storing and reading cookies and other site data, while the document.hasStorageAccess() method checks if such access is granted.

features.name: Clip path boxes
features.description: The fill-box, stroke-box, and view-box values for clip-path set an edge of the element's box to use as the clipping shape.

features.name: Transferable ArrayBuffer
features.description: The transfer() and transferToFixedLength() methods of ArrayBuffer move a buffer from one context to another (for example, to a worker).

features.name: white-space-collapse
features.description: The white-space-collapse CSS property sets whether new line characters are shown as line breaks, and whether multiple consecutive spaces are all displayed or combined.

features.name: View transitions
features.description: View transitions allow you to create animated visual transitions between different states of a document.

features.name: Container style queries
features.description: Container style queries with the @container at-rule apply styles to an element based on the values of custom properties of its container.

features.name: Navigation API
features.description: The navigation API initiates, intercepts, or modifies browser navigation actions. Not to be confused with the navigator API.

features.name: transform-box
features.description: The transform-box CSS property sets the position and dimensions of the reference box relative to which an element's transformations are calculated.

features.name: :user-valid and :user-invalid
features.description: The :user-valid and :user-invalid pseudo-classes match form controls that have been marked as valid or invalid based on their validation constraints.

features.name: AbortSignal.any()
features.description: The AbortSignal.any() static method combines an iterable of abort signals into a single signal, with the abort reason taken from the first signal to abort.

features.name: Array grouping
features.description: The Object.groupBy() and Map.groupBy() static methods group values of arrays and iterables based on a function that returns a key for each value.

features.name: cap unit
features.description: The cap CSS length unit corresponds to the height of Latin capital letters.

features.name: <search>
features.description: The <search> HTML element is a container that represents the parts of the web page with search functionality.

features.name: Masks
features.description: The mask CSS property (and several longhand properties) partially or completely hides an element according to the shape and depth of an image.

features.name: JSON source text access
features.description: To serialize and parse JSON in a lossless way, JSON.stringify() handles rawJSON values and JSON.parse()'s reviver callback takes a source context parameter.

features.name: content-visibility
features.description: The content-visibility CSS property delays rendering an element, including layout and painting, until it is needed.

features.name: Popover
features.description: The popover HTML attribute creates an overlay to display content on top of other page content. Popovers can be shown declaratively using HTML, or using the showPopover() method.

features.name: Exponential functions (CSS)
features.description: The pow(), sqrt(), hypot(), log(), and exp() CSS functions compute various exponential functions.

features.name: transition-behavior
features.description: The transition-behavior: allow-discrete CSS declaration allows transitions for properties whose animation behavior is discrete. Such properties can't be interpolated and swap from their start value to the end value at 50%.

features.name: @starting-style
features.description: The @starting-style CSS at-rule sets the starting values for properties that are transitioning when the target element's style is first updated.

features.name: Promise.withResolvers()
features.description: The Promise.withResolvers() static method is an alternative to the Promise() constructor that returns both the promise and resolution functions. You can use this to access resolve and reject outside the scope of the executor function.

features.name: :dir()
features.description: The :dir() CSS functional pseudo-class matches elements by text direction, either right to left (rtl) or left to right (ltr).

features.name: Typed function references (WebAssembly)
features.description: A typed function reference can be called directly.

features.name: rcap unit
features.description: The rcap CSS length unit is a font-relative length equal to the value of the cap unit on the root element. Cap-height is approximately equal to the height of a capital Latin letter.

features.name: rect() and xywh()
features.description: The rect() CSS function creates a rectangle shape with insets from the edges of an element. The xywh() CSS function creates a rectangle shifted by an x and y distance. They can be used with clip-path and shape-outside.

features.name: Garbage collection (WebAssembly)
features.description: Garbage collection tracks references for better memory management with garbage-collected languages running in WebAssmbly.

features.name: Shared worker
features.description: The SharedWorker() constructor runs a script in its own thread, which can send and receive messages with other scripts running at the same origin.

features.name: Math font family
features.description: The font-family: math CSS declaration uses the browser default font face for displaying mathematical expressions.

features.name: Remote playback
features.description: The Remote Playback API initiates and controls playback of media on connected remote devices, such as smart TVs with AirPlay or Chromecast capabilities.

features.name: scripting media query
features.description: The scripting CSS media query sets styles based on whether scripting such as JavaScript is available. Values are enabled if scripting is available, initial-only if scripting is only available on page load (for example, printed content), or none.

features.name: URL.canParse()
features.description: The URL.canParse() static method checks whether a URL can be parsed into a valid URL object. It's an alternative to calling new URL() in a try … catch statement.

features.name: Nesting
features.description: CSS nesting allows for shorter selectors, easier reading, and more modularity by nesting rules inside others.

features.name: JavaScript modules in shared workers
features.description: The SharedWorker() constructor accepts { type: "module" } to load scripts that use import and export. Also known as ECMAScript modules or ESM in shared workers.

features.name: paint-order
features.description: The paint-order CSS property sets the z-order of strokes, fills, and (in SVG content) markers. For example, paint-order: markers stroke fill; draws the markers, then stroke on top of markers, then fill on top of both markers and stroke.

features.name: navigator.share()
features.description: The navigator.share() method invokes the device's native sharing mechanism and passes text, links, files, and other content to share targets. Also known as the Web Share API.

features.name: scrollend
features.description: The scrollend event fires when an element or document has finished scrolling.

features.name: Array.fromAsync()
features.description: The Array.fromAsync() static method copies items from an async iterable object to make a new array.

features.name: Mutually exclusive <details> elements
features.description: Multiple <details> elements which use the same name attribute are mutually exclusive. When one member of the group is opened, all other members are closed.

features.name: display animation
features.description: You can animate elements between display: none and any other display value or animate between content-visibility: hidden and any other content-visibility value. This also applies to transitions.

features.name: background-clip: text
features.description: The background-clip: text CSS declaration draws the background underneath only the text in the element.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.description: The scrollbar-width CSS property sets the width of the scrollbar.

features.name: light-dark()
features.description: The light-dark() CSS function accepts two colors and uses one depending on the current color scheme.

features.name: AbortSignal.timeout()
features.description: The AbortSignal.timeout() static method returns an abort signal that automatically aborts after a specified duration.

features.name: Set methods
features.description: The difference(), intersection(), isDisjointFrom(), isSubsetOf(), isSupersetOf(), symmetricDifference(), and union() methods of the JavaScript Set object performs operations between two sets.

features.name: align-content in block layouts
features.description: The align-content property vertically aligns content in block layouts, like it does in flex or grid layouts.

features.name: JSON import attributes
features.description: Module import … with { type: "json" } statements load JSON data. Also known as JSON module scripts.

features.name: Vertical form controls
features.description: The writing-mode CSS property orients form elements (such as radio buttons, progress bars, or select menus) vertically when the writing mode is vertical-lr or vertical-rl. The direction CSS property sets whether inputs flow from top to bottom or bottom to top.

features.name: ClipboardItem.supports()
features.description: The ClipboardItem.supports() static method checks if the browser supports writing data types such as "image/svg+xml" or other custom formats to the system clipboard.

features.name: round(), mod(), and rem()
features.description: The round(), mod(), and rem() CSS functions compute rounded values and the remainder after division.

features.name: Scroll-driven animations
features.description: The animation-timeline, scroll-timeline, and view-timeline CSS properties advance animations based on the user's scroll position.

features.name: Iterator methods
features.description: The Iterator object is an abstract base for objects that implement the iterator protocol. It provides methods common to built-in iterators, such as filter(), find(), map(), and reduce(). You can also use the static method Iterator.from() to convert an existing iterable into an Iterator.

features.name: font-size-adjust
features.description: The font-size-adjust CSS property preserves apparent text size, regardless of the font used, by scaling fonts to the same size with respect to a specific metric, such as x-height. This can help make fallback fonts look the same size.

features.name: ::spelling-error and ::grammar-error
features.description: The ::spelling-error and ::grammar-error CSS pseudo-elements match text that is highlighted as misspelled and grammatically incorrect, respectively.

features.name: :state()
features.description: The :state() CSS pseudo-class matches custom elements based on their custom state, set through the ElementInternals.states API.

features.name: text-wrap: pretty
features.description: The text-wrap: pretty CSS declaration prioritizes better layout over speed when text is broken into multiple lines.

features.name: Intl.DurationFormat
features.description: The Intl.DurationFormat API creates a locale-aware formatter that turns an object representing a duration (such as days, hours, and minutes) into a string.

features.name: getHTML()
features.description: The getHTML() method of Element and ShadowRoot objects serializes an element's DOM to an HTML string.

features.name: Relative colors
