features.description: The from keyword for color functions (color(), hsl(), oklch(), etc.) creates a new color based on a given color by modifying the values of the input color. Also known as relative color syntax (RCS).

features.name: ruby-align
features.description: The ruby-align CSS property sets the spacing and alignment of ruby annotation text when it does not fill its available space.

features.name: scrollbar-color
features.description: The scrollbar-color CSS property sets the color of the scrollbar track and thumb.

features.name: view-transition-class
features.description: The view-transition-class CSS property sets a name that can be used to apply styles to multiple named view transition pseudo-elements.

features.name: Active view transition
features.description: The :active-view-transition CSS pseudo-class matches the root element when a view transition is active. The :active-view-transition-type() CSS pseudo-class matches only when the active view transition was started with the specified type.

features.name: text-wrap
features.description: The text-wrap CSS property sets how lines break in text that overflows the container. It is a shorthand for text-wrap-style and text-wrap-mode.

features.name: Intl.Locale info
features.description: The getter methods of the Intl.Locale API provide supplemental information about a Unicode locale, such as the locale's calendar (for example, the first day in a week or the weekend start day), writing direction, 12- or 24-hour cycles, and numbering system.

features.name: Promise.try()
features.description: The Promise.try() static method returns a promise that takes a callback of any kind (returns or throws, synchronously or asynchronously) and wraps its result in a Promise.

features.name: Spelling and grammar text decorations
features.description: The text-decoration-line: spelling-error and text-decoration-line: grammar-error CSS declarations apply the browser's marking for spelling and grammatical mistakes. This is typically a wavy underline in red or green.

features.name: ::selection
features.description: The ::selection CSS pseudo-element selects text a user has highlighted.

features.name: beforeunload
features.description: The beforeunload event is fired when the current window is about to be unloaded. Typically this is used to display a dialog to confirm if users really want to leave the page when there is unsaved data that would be lost.

features.name: Media source
features.description: The MediaSource API is a custom data source for media elements commonly used for adaptive streaming. Also known as Media Source Extensions (MSE).

features.name: Wheel events
features.description: The wheel event fires when the user moves a mouse wheel or similar spatially rotating input device.

features.name: background-attachment
features.description: The background-attachment CSS property sets whether an element's background image or gradient moves as the element scrolls.

features.name: writingsuggestions
features.description: The writingsuggestions HTML attribute turns on or off a browser's writing suggestions. Writing suggestions vary by browser. For example, if turned on then a browser might show inline text completions accepted by pressing Tab.

features.name: Cursor styles
features.description: The cursor CSS property styles the pointer, allowing you to provide hints to the user on how to interact with the hovered element.

features.name: resize (CSS property)
features.description: The resize CSS property sets whether an element can be resized by the user, and on which axes.

features.name: <link rel="expect">
features.description: The rel="expect" attribute for the <link> HTML element is a hint to the browser to block rendering until the element that the href value references is connected to the document and fully parsed.

features.name: EXT_float_blend WebGL extension
features.description: The EXT_float_blend extension for WebGL 1.0 and 2.0 contexts adds 32-bit floating-point components to blending and draw buffers.

features.name: Fullscreen API
features.description: The fullscreen API makes a specific element fill the whole screen and hides most browser UI.

features.name: overflow-anchor
features.description: The overflow-anchor CSS property sets an element as a possible scroll anchor, reducing unintended scrolling when document changes occur above the current scrollport. This is enabled by default where supported.

features.name: print-color-adjust
features.description: The print-color-adjust CSS property sets whether styles of printed pages should be adjusted to use less ink, in cases such as light text on a dark background.

features.name: field-sizing
features.description: The field-sizing CSS property allows form controls such as <textarea> to be sized based on their content.

features.name: ::details-content
features.description: The ::details-content pseudo-element selects the expandable content of a <details> element, excluding the <summary>.

features.name: Zstandard compression
features.description: Zstandard or zstd is a fast lossless compression algorithm. When used as a content encoding, it is often faster and offers better compression than brotli.

features.name: Cross-document view transitions
features.description: The @view-transition CSS rule sets whether a document opts-in to transitions between documents in a multi-page application. Both the old and new document must opt-in for a transition to be triggered.

features.name: Unsanitized HTML parsing
features.description: The Document.parseHTMLUnsafe() static method parses HTML into a DOM tree, much like the setHTMLUnsafe() DOM method inserts HTML into an existing tree. No sanitization applies, so never call it with user-provided strings.

features.name: abs() and sign()
features.description: The abs() and sign() CSS functions compute the absolute value or the sign of the input.

features.name: Top-level await
features.description: The await keyword, when used at the top level of a module (outside of an async function), delays parent module execution until after a promise fulfills.

features.name: document.caretPositionFromPoint()
features.description: The document.caretPositionFromPoint() method finds an insertion point, represented by a DOM node and an offset within that node, for given coordinates in the viewport.

features.name: Atomics.pause()
features.description: The Atomics.pause() static method gives a hint to the CPU that the code calling the method is in a short-duration wait for shared memory, known as spinning or a spinlock.

features.name: Branch hinting (WebAssembly)
features.description: Branch hints in WebAssembly allows a browser to optimize performance when a branch is a likely to take a specific path.

features.name: <link rel="prefetch">
features.description: The rel="prefetch" attribute for the <link> HTML element is a hint to the browser that the user is likely to navigate to a resource, so the browser should preemptively fetch and cache the resource.

features.name: devicePixelRatio
features.description: The window.devicePixelRatio property is the ratio of the size of one CSS pixel to the vertical size of one physical pixel on the current display device.

features.name: window.external
features.description: The window.external.AddSearchProvider() and window.external.IsSearchProviderInstalled() do nothing. Historically, they added external search providers to the browser.

features.name: 2D canvas opacity
features.description: The optional alpha parameter of a 2D canvas's getContext() method sets whether the canvas has an alpha transparency channel. If set to false, then this permits the browser to optimize compositing for an opaque canvas.

features.name: requestIdleCallback()
features.description: The requestIdleCallback() API queues a function that runs in idle browser time, either at the end of a frame or when the user is inactive. Also known as the background tasks API.

features.name: showPicker() for <input>
features.description: The showPicker() method for <input> elements shows the user interface for picking a value. For example, for <input type="date"> it shows the interface for picking a date.

features.name: user-select
features.description: The user-select CSS property controls which elements can be selected by the user.

features.name: SharedArrayBuffer in WebGL
features.description: SharedArrayBuffer objects can be used in WebGL APIs that previously only worked with ArrayBuffer objects.

features.name: Customized built-in elements
features.description: Customized built-in elements are HTML elements that extend built-in elements using the is attribute, to add new behaviors that you define.

features.name: Gamepad touch buttons
features.description: The touched property of a GamepadButton object indicates whether a button capable of detecting touch is currently touched.

features.name: Web MIDI
features.description: The Web MIDI API enables selecting MIDI input and output devices and sending and receiving MIDI messages.

features.name: Float16Array
features.description: Float16Array is a typed array of 16-bit floating point numbers.

features.name: Serializable errors
features.description: The DOMException, Error, EvalError, RangeError, ReferenceError, SyntaxError, TypeError, and URIError objects are serializable. You can call structuredClone() on an error object or pass it to a worker using postMessage().

features.name: Selection composed ranges
features.description: The window.getSelection().getComposedRanges() method returns ranges that represent the current user selection, even if the selection spans across shadow tree boundaries.

features.name: Fetch metadata request headers
features.description: The Sec-Fetch-Dest, Sec-Fetch-Mode, Sec-Fetch-Site, and Sec-Fetch-User HTTP headers provide extra information about the way a request was made, to help servers reject certain kinds of malicious requests.

features.name: dialog.requestClose()
features.description: The requestClose() method of a <dialog> HTML element closes the dialog, firing a cancel event first, which listeners can use to prevent the dialog from closing. This differs from the close() method, which only fires the non-cancelable close event.

features.name: Gamepad haptic feedback
features.description: The gamepad.vibrationActuator property represents a gamepad's haptics hardware, which allows you to control the vibration motors in a gamepad.

features.name: RegExp.escape()
features.description: The RegExp.escape() static method takes a string and replaces any characters that are potentially special characters of a regular expression with equivalent escape sequences. For example, RegExp.escape("[abc]") returns "\\[abc\\]".

features.name: ::marker
features.description: The ::marker CSS pseudo-element selects list item markers for styling numbers or bullets.

features.name: Anchor positioning animations and transitions
features.description: The anchor() and anchor-size() CSS functions animate or transition on changes such as the anchor box moving or the anchor element changing.

features.name: Font metric overrides
features.description: The ascent-override, descent-override, and line-gap-override descriptors adjust the display of a font declared in an @font-face statement. This can help make fallback fonts look the same size.

features.name: Transferable streams
features.description: Streams are transferable objects, which can be moved between contexts such as windows and workers.

features.name: text-box
features.description: The text-box CSS property sets the spacing above and below text based on a font's typographic features. For example, text-box: trim-both ex alphabetic trims the top to the top of the letter x and the bottom to the bottom of most letters, without descenders.

features.name: shape()
features.description: The shape() CSS function creates shapes with a series of commands like line, move, and curve. It can be used with clip-path and shape-outside.

features.name: path()
features.description: The path() CSS shape function creates a shape for clip-path, shape-outside, and the SVG attribute d.

features.name: captureStream() for <audio> and <video>
features.description: The captureStream() method for <audio> and <video> elements returns a MediaStream for the media element's content. You can use this to record media or send it elsewhere, such as a canvas or WebRTC connection.

features.name: Multiple import maps
features.description: Multiple <script type="importmap"> HTML elements merge to produce the overall import map.

features.name: Exception references with exnref (WebAssembly)
features.description: When caught, an exception is reified into an exception reference, a value of the new type exnref.

features.name: page-orientation
features.description: The page-orientation CSS property sets the rotation of a page after pagination. This allows pages with the same size declaration to display with different orientations.

features.name: Cookie store
features.description: The CookieStore API is an asynchronous and promise-based API for managing cookies. It does not rely on document and so is available to service workers as well.

features.name: Application shortcuts
features.description: The shortcuts web app manifest member registers common actions of an installed web app with the device. The device can present these actions to the user in contextually appropriate locations, such as jump lists on Windows or the app launcher on Android.

features.name: WebRTC encoded transform
features.description: The WebRTC encoded transform API allows you to modify audio and video streams in WebRTC connections. For example, it can be used for visual effects or custom codecs.

features.name: WebOTP
features.description: The OTPCredential API represents a one-time-password (OTP).

features.name: COLRv1
features.description: COLRv1 is a font format that supports multi-color glyphs. COLRv1 extends COLRv0 to support gradients, transforms, and blending modes.

features.name: Page break aliases
features.description: The page-break-before, page-break-inside, and page-break-after CSS properties are aliases to the break-before, break-inside, and break-after properties.

features.name: Battery status
features.description: The navigator.getBattery() API obtains information about the device's battery, including charge level and status. Also known as the Battery API.

features.name: Vibration
features.description: The navigator.vibrate() method makes a tactile alert, if the device is equipped with a haptic motor.

features.name: Crash reporting
features.description: Crash reporting sends a report to a URL nominated by the Reporting-Endpoints header when a user is unable to continue using the page because the browser or tab crashed.

features.name: Presentation API
features.description: The Presentation API shows or controls content on another display, such as a network-connected TV or projector.

features.name: Background sync
features.description: The background synchronization API registers a service worker callback to run only when the device is no longer offline. You can use this to let users continue using your app while offline and synchronize with a server after reconnecting.

features.name: Federated credentials
features.description: The FederatedCredential API represents the details required to authenticate a user using a third-party identity provider. Not to be confused with federated credential management (FedCM).

features.name: :host-context()
features.description: The :host-context() CSS pseudo-class selects the containing element of the shadow tree in which it is used if that element or an ancestor matches the provided selector.

features.name: text-size-adjust
features.description: The text-size-adjust CSS property disables or modifies the browser's default text size adjustment for small screen sizes.

features.name: controlslist
features.description: The controlslist attribute for <audio> or <video> hides parts of the browser's built-in controls. For example, controlslist="nofullscreen" removes the button to play the video in fullscreen.

features.name: Long task performance entries
features.description: A longtask performance entry measures tasks that occupy the UI thread for 50 milliseconds or more, a metric for input latency, delayed animations, and other sources of "jank."

features.name: Password credentials
features.description: The PasswordCredential API represents a username and password.

features.name: Web Bluetooth
features.description: The Web Bluetooth API enables selecting and communicating with nearby Bluetooth devices.

features.name: WebUSB
features.description: The WebUSB API exposes USB compatible devices to web pages.

features.name: paint()
features.description: The paint() CSS function creates a custom image, drawn using a paint worklet, for an element's background or border.

features.name: Save-Data
features.description: Browsers send the Save-Data HTTP request header when the user turns on a data-saving mode. It is a hint to reduce data sent to the browser. Servers should respond with alternative content, such as smaller images and videos, or different markup and styling.

features.name: Gyroscope
features.description: The Gyroscope API reads the angular velocity of a device in three dimensions.

features.name: Orientation Sensor
features.description: The AbsoluteOrientationSensor and RelativeOrientationSensor APIs describe the physical orientation of a device in three-dimensional space, either in relation to the Earth's coordinate system or in relation to the device's own orientation, respectively.

features.name: Keyboard lock
features.description: The navigator.keyboard.lock() API allows you to capture keys that are normally reserved by the operating system. It can be used to provide an immersive fullscreen experience such as games.

features.name: Page lifecycle
features.description: The page lifecycle API helps you safely handle page suspensions or discards from memory. The freeze and resume events fire when the browser suspends or resumes a page from memory while the document.wasDiscarded property reports whether the page was reloaded after being dropped.

features.name: Deprecation reports
features.description: Deprecation reporting sends a report to a URL nominated by the Reporting-Endpoints header or the ReportingObserver API when a page uses a deprecated API or other browser feature.

features.name: Intervention reports
features.description: Intervention reporting sends a report to a URL nominated by the Reporting-Endpoints header when the browser has not honored an application's request, contrary to specified behavior, such as for security or privacy reasons.

features.name: Keyboard map
features.description: The navigator.keyboard.getLayoutMap() API returns a map from key codes to human readable key names. It can be used to describe buttons to the user when using the keyboard as a set of buttons, such as in games.

features.name: Payment handler
features.description: The payment handler API registers a web application as a payment handler and responds to payment requests in the browser's user interface, rather than redirecting users to a separate site to complete a payment.

features.name: contextlost and contextrestored
features.description: The contextlost event for <canvas> fires when the canvas backing storage is lost, while the contextrestored event fires when it is recreated.

features.name: Background fetch
features.description: Background fetch downloads data in the background even when the web page is closed.

features.name: Feature policy
features.description: The Feature-Policy response header sets whether a policy-controlled feature, such as an API, may be used in a document. Not to be confused with permissions policy.

features.name: Intersection observer visibility tracking
features.description: The trackVisibility parameter for the IntersectionObserver constructor enables tracking the visibility of an element, to detect if it may be obscured by other content or visual effects. Also known as IntersectionObserver v2.

features.name: beforeinstallprompt
features.description: The beforeinstallprompt event fires when a Progressive Web App (PWA) is installable. You can cancel the event and later call event.prompt() to control when the installation prompt is shown. The appinstalled event fires when the PWA is successfully installed.

features.name: Element timing performance entries
features.description: An element performance entry measures the time to render elements that have the elementtiming attribute.

features.name: Desynchronized WebGL canvas
features.description: The optional desynchronized parameter of a canvas's getContext() method permits the browser to draw a WebGL canvas independently of the event loop. This can reduce drawing latency.

features.name: Desynchronized WebGL2 canvas
features.description: The optional desynchronized parameter of a canvas's getContext() method permits the browser to draw a WebGL2 canvas independently of the event loop. This can reduce drawing latency.

features.name: :open
features.description: The :open CSS pseudo-class matches elements that have open states, like <details>, <dialog>, or <select>, based on their state.

features.name: Gamepad (WebXR)
features.description: The gamepad attribute of an XRInputSource represents an XR input device, such as a motion controller, that reports data from physical inputs (such as buttons, touch pads, and triggers).

features.name: WebXR
features.description: The navigator.xr API represents the browser's virtual reality or augmented reality system. You can use to request a WebXR session.

features.name: Web authentication signal methods
features.description: The signalUnknownCredential(), signalAllAcceptedCredentials(), and signalCurrentUserDetails() methods of PublicKeyCredential inform authenticators of the state of public key credentials, so that incorrect or revoked credentials may be updated, removed, or hidden.

features.name: Periodic background sync
features.description: The periodic background synchronization API fires a recurring periodicsync event in a service worker. You can use this to update data in the background at regular intervals.

features.name: Hit test
features.description: The getHitTestResults() method of an XRFrame object helps place objects in an augmented reality session by finding where cast rays intersect with real-world geometry.

features.name: DOM overlays for WebXR
features.description: A DOM overlay shows 2D DOM content as an interactive, transparent layer on top of a WebXR application's WebGL content and camera image.

features.name: Share targets
features.description: The share_target web app manifest member registers an installed web app as a handler for shared content. When a user shares content by using the device share dialog, the installed app can be listed as an option for handling the shared content.

features.name: Anchors (WebXR)
features.description: An XRAnchor object keeps track of a pose that is fixed relative to the real world. Anchors build an illusion that the placed objects are really present in the user's environment.

features.name: Layout instability performance entries
features.description: A layout-shift performance entry measures the layout stability of web pages based on movements of the elements on the page. They're used to calculate cumulative layout shift (CLS), a common metric for perceived stability.

features.name: Augmented reality
features.description: The "immersive-ar" value for navigator.xr.requestSession() starts an augmented reality WebXR session that renders content aligned with the visible environment.

features.name: Invoker commands
features.description: The command and commandfor attributes for the <button> HTML element dispatch an action to an element when the button is invoked (by click or keystroke), as a declarative alternative to addEventListener() calls or onclick attribute handlers.

features.name: cookieStore.get() metadata
features.description: The cookieStore.get() method returns cookie metadata, such as the domain, expires, path, sameSite and secure properties.

features.name: isInputPending()
features.description: The navigator.scheduling.isInputPending() method checks if there are pending input events, such as touch or mouse events. This allows you to yield from long-running scripts that might be blocking user interaction.

features.name: Uint8Array base64 and hex conversion
features.description: The Uint8Array.fromBase64() static method and the toBase64() and setFromBase64() instance methods convert to and from base64 strings. Similarly, the Uint8Array.fromHex() static method and the toHex() and setFromHex() instance methods convert to and from hex strings.

features.name: Memory measurement
features.description: The measureUserAgentSpecificMemory() method estimates the memory usage of a web application including all its iframes and workers.

features.name: Depth sensing
features.description: An XRDepthInformation object represents a measurement of the distance from the user's device to the real-world geometry in the user's environment.

features.name: Lighting estimation
features.description: The XRLightProbe and XRLightEstimate objects represent real-world environmental lighting conditions during a WebXR session.

features.name: User agent client hints
features.description: The Sec-CH-UA HTTP request header and the navigator.userAgentData API expose browser and platform information used to vary responses and application logic. User agent client hints are similar to user agent strings but more privacy-preserving and safer to parse.

features.name: Accelerometer
features.description: The Accelerometer, LinearAccelerationSensor and GravitySensor APIs read the acceleration applied to a device in three dimensions, either including the effect of gravity, without its effect, or only its effect, respectively.

features.name: hidden="until-found"
features.description: The hidden="until-found" attribute hides an element until it is found using the browser's find-in-page search or it is directly navigated to by following a URL fragment.

features.name: Ink
features.description: The navigator.ink API uses the system compositor to draw to a <canvas> element ahead of pointer events, reducing the delay between moving a stylus or cursor and a pen stroke appearing on screen.

features.name: Profiler
features.description: The Profiler API records data about the execution of a page, which you can send to a server for later analysis. Also known as self-profiling.

features.name: Virtual keyboard
features.description: The navigator.virtualKeyboard API inspects and controls on-screen virtual keyboards. You can use it to programmatically hide or show a virtual keyboard or respond to the keyboard disappearing or appearing.

features.name: Idle detection
features.description: The IdleDetector API is used to notify a webpage of the user's idle, active, and locked state.

features.name: Device memory
features.description: The navigator.deviceMemory property is the approximate amount of device memory, in gigabytes.

features.name: progress()
features.description: The progress() CSS function returns a ratio for the relative position of one value between two other values, clamped between 0 and 1. You can use it to interpolate a value for other calculations.

features.name: sibling-count() and sibling-index()
features.description: The sibling-count() and sibling-index() CSS functions return integers that are useful to style elements based on their positions among siblings or on the number of siblings, for example as part of a calc() expression.

features.name: WebGPU
features.description: The navigator.gpu API performs operations such as rendering and computation on dedicated graphics hardware (also known as a Graphics Processing Unit).

features.name: Column breaks
features.description: In columnar layouts (created by the columns or column-count CSS properties), the break-after, break-before, break-inside properties control where columns start or end.

features.name: Hyphenate limit chars
features.description: The hyphenate-limit-chars CSS property sets the number of characters in a word before it is hyphenated and the minimum number of characters on either side of the hyphen.

features.name: Custom formats for clipboard items
features.description: The web  prefix for ClipboardItem data types (also known as MIME types) allows reading and writing unsanitized custom data from the device clipboard.

features.name: object-view-box
features.description: The object-view-box CSS property crops and zooms to an inset area of an image.

features.name: baseline-source
features.description: The baseline-source CSS property controls how inline-level boxes with multiple lines of text are aligned with the surrounding text. By default, which typographic baseline is used depends on the display property value.

features.name: Fetch upload streams
features.description: The fetch() method and Request() constructor accept a ReadableStream object as the request's body option, to stream upload data to the server.

features.name: text-decoration in ::selection
features.description: The text-decoration CSS property in a ::selection rule sets the underline and other text decoration styles on the text a user has highlighted.

features.name: Raw camera access for WebXR
features.description: The XRView.camera property provides direct access to pose-synchronized camera images within a WebXR session.

features.name: Pointer lock
features.description: Provides access to raw mouse movement by locking the target of mouse events to a single element and hiding the mouse cursor.

features.name: Permissions policy
features.description: The Permissions-Policy response header and the allow attribute for <iframe> elements sets whether a policy-controlled feature, such as an API, may be used in a document.

features.name: File system access
features.description: The showOpenFilePicker(), showDirectoryPicker(), and showSaveFilePicker() methods request access to files and directories on the user's device and returns a handle for reading and writing to them.

features.name: Speculation rules
features.description: Speculation rules are hints to the browser to proactively download pages in the background so they appear instantly when the user navigates to them.

features.name: Relaxed-width SIMD (WebAssembly)
features.description: Relaxed SIMD (Single Instruction Multiple Data) introduces local non-determinism, where the results of the instructions may vary based on hardware support.

features.name: ToggleEvent source
features.description: The source property of a ToggleEvent object is the element which triggered the toggle event to fire for a popover, <dialog>, or <details> element, if applicable.

features.name: Credentialless iframes
features.description: The credentialless attribute for the <iframe> HTML element loads third-party content in an ephemeral context and does not send any credentials such as cookies. When using cross-origin isolation, this allows you to embed content that does not send Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy headers.

features.name: initial-letter
features.description: The initial-letter CSS property sets the number of lines the first letter of an element occupies. You can use the property to make a raised capital or drop cap.

features.name: Digital credentials
features.description: The digital credentials API issues and requests digital credentials, such as driver's licenses or ID cards, with the browser or operating system. Digital credentials extend the navigator.credentials credential management API.

features.name: @scope
features.description: The @scope CSS at-rule sets the scope for a group of rules.

features.name: Partitioned cookies
features.description: Partitioned cookies allow you to opt a cookie into partitioned storage, with a separate cookie jar per top-level site. Also known as Cookies Having Independent Partitioned State or CHIPS.

features.name: text-indent: each-line
features.description: The text-indent: each-line CSS declaration indents text after forced breaks as well as to the first line of a block.

features.name: text-indent: hanging
features.description: The text-indent: hanging CSS declaration indents all lines except the first.

features.name: Page visibility state performance entries
features.description: A visibility-state performance entry measures the timing of page visibility state changes, such as when a tab is no longer visible or the user has switched to another app.

features.name: Federated credential management
features.description: The IdentityCredential API delegates authentication to a third-party identity provider, instead of using third-party cookies. Also known as FedCM.

features.name: Multi-memory (WebAssembly)
features.description: A single module in WebAssembly can have multiple memories.

features.name: Asynchronously iterable streams
features.description: Asynchronous iteration of a stream allows you to use for await … of loops to iterate through a stream's incoming data.

features.name: overlay
features.description: The overlay CSS property, used as an allow-discrete CSS transition, prevents a top layer element, such as a popover or a <dialog>, from being removed from the top layer before it has finished animating. You can't set the value of the overlay property; only use it as transition property.

features.name: crisp-edges
features.description: The image-rendering: crisp-edges CSS declaration scales images to preserve lines without blurring.

features.name: prefers-reduced-transparency media query
features.description: The prefers-reduced-transparency CSS media query sets styles based on whether the user prefers to reduce the amount of transparent effects on their device, for example to improve contrast and legibility.

features.name: word-break: auto-phrase
features.description: The word-break: auto-phrase CSS declaration specifies that wrapping should occur at natural phrase boundaries, especially in CJK languages.

features.name: Related website sets
features.description: Related website sets declares relationships between sites so the browser allows cookie and storage access between them through methods such as document.requestStorageAccessFor().

features.name: text-decoration-skip-ink: all
features.description: The text-decoration-skip-ink: all CSS declaration forces interruptions in underlines and overlines where the line would cross a glyph. This contrasts with auto, which does not skip for CJK glyphs.

features.name: showPicker() for <select>
features.description: The showPicker() method for <select> elements shows the dropdown menu or other user interface for picking one of the options.

features.name: Service workers static routing
features.description: The service worker install event's addRoutes method declares resource paths that should either be fetched from the network or the cache, to bypass the service worker and improve performance.

features.name: Web serial
features.description: The navigator.serial API communicates with devices over serial ports, such as microcontrollers.

features.name: Permissions policy violation reporting
features.description: Permissions policy violation reporting sends a report to a URL nominated by the Reporting-Endpoints header or the ReportingObserver API when a page violates a policy. You can also use the Permissions-Policy-Report-Only header to receive reports of what might break under a given policy.

features.name: Virtual sensors
features.description: The CreateVirtualSensor WebDriver command creates a virtual sensor for testing applications that use sensor APIs, without the need for real device sensors.

features.name: CSS import attributes
features.description: Module import … with { type: "css" } statements load CSS modules as constructable stylesheets. Also known as CSS module scripts.

features.name: context-fill and context-stroke
features.description: The context-fill and context-stroke CSS values are used with fill and stroke in SVG <marker> or <use> elements to match a color from where they appear.

features.name: Map getOrInsert()
features.description: The getOrInsert() and getOrInsertComputed() methods of Map objects get a value, setting and getting a default value if needed.

features.name: WebDriver BiDi
features.description: WebDriver BiDi is a bidirectional protocol that allows a WebDriver client and a browser to communicate with each other.

features.name: EditContext
features.description: The EditContext API allows you to build rich text editors that support advanced text input, such as Input Method Editor (IME) composition, an emoji picker, or other platform-specific editing UI.

features.name: font-palette animation
features.description: You can animate color fonts between two font-palette values.

features.name: box-decoration-break
features.description: The box-decoration-break CSS property sets whether box decorations, such as borders or backgrounds, of an element divided across a page, column, or region wraps each fragment or splits across the break.

features.name: Read unsanitized clipboard data
features.description: The optional formats.unsanitized parameter of the navigator.clipboard.read() method reads unsanitized text/html data from the system clipboard.

features.name: Storage buckets
features.description: The navigator.storageBuckets API allows you to organize locally stored data into groups called storage buckets. Each bucket can have different settings, allowing the browser to manage and delete buckets independently rather than applying the same treatment to all.

features.name: Long animation frames performance entries
features.description: A long-animation-frame performance entry measures rendering updates that take longer than 50 milliseconds. Also known as LoAFs.

features.name: text-spacing-trim
features.description: The text-spacing-trim CSS property controls spacing around CJK characters, avoiding excessive whitespace when using full-width punctuation characters.

features.name: CloseWatcher
features.description: The CloseWatcher API listens and responds to close requests on in-page components, such as modals, popovers, and sidebars.

The sizes="auto" attribute for the HTML element sets the layout size for the image based on the computed layout size when choosing a source from the srcset. This attribute only applies to images with the loading="lazy" attribute.

features.name: String builtins (WebAssembly)
features.description: The WebAssembly builtin string functions mirror a subset of the JavaScript String API and adapt it to be efficiently callable without JavaScript glue code.

features.name: Scheduler API
features.description: The scheduler API provides a way to prioritize all tasks belonging to an application.

features.name: font-variant-emoji
features.description: The font-variant-emoji CSS property sets the default presentation for emoji characters.

features.name: SVG clipboard items
features.description: The image/svg+xml data type (also known as the MIME type) for ClipboardItem objects represents SVG data written to or read from the clipboard.

features.name: Origin
features.description: An Origin object represents an origin, as in a scheme, hostname, and port. You can use it to make same-site and same-origin comparisons.

features.name: Back/forward cache blocking reasons
features.description: The notRestoredReasons property of a PerformanceNavigationTiming object explains why the current document was blocked from using the back/forward cache (also known as the bfcache) on navigation.

features.name: Iterator.concat()
features.description: The Iterator.concat() JavaScript method returns an iterator that yields values from a sequence of iterators, exhausting each iterator before moving on to the next.

features.name: Scoped custom element registries
features.description: The CustomElementRegistry() constructor creates a new custom element registry that's separate from the global window.customElements registry. Creating more than one registry is useful for multiple custom elements that have the same tag name to coexist.

features.name: contrast-color()
features.description: The contrast-color() CSS function picks a color that has guaranteed contrast against a specified foreground or background color.

features.name: Memory64 (WebAssembly)
features.description: Instructions accept 64-bit memory indexes.

features.name: calc-size()
features.description: The calc-size() CSS function computes mathematical expressions that include height and width keyword values, for example calc-size(fit-content, size / 2). Not to be confused with the calc() CSS function, which cannot use keyword values.

features.name: interpolate-size
features.description: The interpolate-size CSS property sets whether animations and transitions interpolate between a numeric value and a keyword value, such as from a fixed length to auto or fit-content.

features.name: Math.sumPrecise()
features.description: The Math.sumPrecise() static method returns the sum of an iterable of numbers. It avoids the precision loss of intermediate partial sums, as found using reduce() or a loop to add together an array of values.

features.name: Scroll snap events
features.description: The scrollsnapchanging and scrollsnapchange events fire when a scroll gesture changes the selected scroll snap target.

features.name: Virtual pressure sources
features.description: The CreateVirtualPressureSource WebDriver command creates artificial sources of compute pressure for testing without the need real device sources of compute pressure.

features.name: moveBefore()
features.description: The moveBefore() DOM method relocates a node while preserving its state. For example, you can move the active element without losing focus, move an animated element without resetting the animation, or move an iframe without reloading its content.

features.name: Compression Dictionary Transport
features.description: Compression Dictionary Transport is a mechanism for using designated HTTP responses as an external dictionary for future HTTP responses for compression schemes that support using external dictionaries (e.g., Brotli and Zstandard)

features.name: justify-self in block layouts
features.description: The justify-self CSS property aligns an item along a container's inline axis in block layouts, like it does in grid layouts. Likewise, the justify-items property sets a default justify-self value for all items in a container in a block layout.

features.name: JavaScript promise integration (WebAssembly)
features.description: The JavaScript promise integration (JSPI) suspends a WebAssembly module when it calls a JavaScript method that returns a promise. The module resumes when the promise is resolved. You can use this to call asynchronous Web APIs from synchronous WebAssembly.

features.name: attr()
features.description: The attr() CSS function, in the context of any property, returns the value of an attribute of an HTML element, with the option to return it as a specific type or unit. You can set a default value for missing or invalid attributes.

features.name: Customizable <select>
features.description: The <select> element's appearance, including the button, selected option, picker dropdown, and options, can be customized using CSS.

features.name: Error.isError()
features.description: The Error.isError() static method checks whether a value is an Error object.

features.name: <dialog closedby>
features.description: The closedby HTML attribute for <dialog> sets which user actions close a dialog. For example, closedby="any" allows the dialog to be closed by clicking outside of it.

features.name: Explicit resource management
features.description: The using and await using declarations and the dispose and asyncDispose symbols manage the lifecycle of resources such as file handles and streams. The DisposableStack and AsyncDisposableStack objects can group, dispose, and coordinate dependencies between multiple disposable resources.

features.name: Device posture
features.description: The device posture API and the device-posture CSS media feature reflect the physical posture of a device, such as whether a foldable device is folded or unfolded.

features.name: background-clip: border-area
features.description: The background-clip: border-area CSS declaration draws the background underneath only the border of an element.

features.name: Name-only container queries
features.description: Name-only container queries with the @container … at-rule apply styles to an element based on the name of the element's container alone.

features.name: Attribution reporting
features.description: The attribution reporting API measures when an ad click or view leads to a conversion, such as a purchase on an advertiser site.

features.name: Container scroll-state queries
features.description: Container scroll-state queries with the @container scroll-state(...) at-rule apply styles to an element based on the sticky positioning, snapped, and scrollable state of the container.

features.name: scroll-initial-target
features.description: The scroll-initial-target: nearest CSS declaration sets the initial scroll position of its scroll container to the top of the element, much like scrolling to a URL fragment.

features.name: stretch
features.description: The stretch CSS keyword expands a box as needed to fit its contents until the maximum size is reached, without preserving the content's preferred aspect ratio.

features.name: <meta name="application-title">
features.description: The name="application-title" attribute for the <meta> HTML element sets an installed web application's title bar text.

features.name: Shared storage locks
features.description: The withLock option to set(), append(), delete(), clear(), and batchUpdate() methods of the sharedStorage API prevents duplicate reporting from cross-site race conditions.

features.name: ::column
features.description: The ::column CSS pseudo-element represents the individual columns of a multi-column layout container. Columns can only be styled with scroll snap CSS properties and can also have a ::scroll-marker pseudo-element, which scrolls to the column when activated.

features.name: ::scroll-button
features.description: The ::scroll-button(<dir>) CSS pseudo-element is a focusable button which scrolls its originating scroll container element in the specified direction.

features.name: fetchLater
features.description: The fetchLater() method requests a deferred fetch sent at an unknown time. The browser chooses a reliable time to send the request, ideally when the document is unloaded, and ignores the response. This API is useful for sending beacons to a server without expecting a particular response.

features.name: interactivity
features.description: The interactivity: inert CSS declaration makes an element and its descendants inert, like when using the inert HTML attribute. Inert elements can't be focused or clicked, their text can't be selected or found using the browser's find-in-page feature.

features.name: Observable
features.description: The when() method on a event target returns an Observable object, which provides a declarative API for subscribing to and operating on events. It's an alternative to addEventListener() callbacks.

features.name: Scroll markers
features.description: A scroll marker scrolls a container to a scroll target. The ::scroll-marker CSS pseudo-element selects a scroll marker in a ::scroll-marker-group pseudo-element, generated before or after the scroll container. You can use them to navigate and style tables of contents, tab panels, and carousels.

features.name: ariaNotify()
features.description: The ariaNotify() method of Element and Document requests assistive technology software, if activated, to announce a message to the user. This can help make dynamic content changes more accessible to users.

features.name: dynamic-range-limit
features.description: The dynamic-range-limit CSS property controls the peak luminance of high dynamic range content. You can use this to coordinate the apparent brightness of HDR and SDR content.

features.name: if()
features.description: The if() CSS function is an inline conditional value that returns a value based on a set of conditions.

features.name: reading-flow
features.description: The reading-flow CSS property sets the order in which flex or grid elements are rendered to speech or reached via focus navigation. The reading-order property overrides this order.

features.name: Viewport segments
features.description: The viewport segment CSS environment variables and media features, and the viewport.segments API, allow you to adapt your layout to devices where the display is split, such as on foldable devices.

features.name: cross-origin() for url()
features.description: The url() CSS function accepts a cross-origin() modifier to control cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) when requesting the URL. For example, url("https://example.com" cross-origin(anonymous))) does not send credentials to the URL.

features.name: referrer-policy() for url()
features.description: The url() CSS function accepts a referrer-policy() modifier to choose which referrer to send when requesting the URL.  For example, `url("https://example.com" referrer-policy(no-referrer)) does not send a referrer to the URL.

features.name: Custom highlights from point
features.description: The CSS.highlights.highlightsFromPoint() method returns an array of Highlight objects at a specified point.

features.name: font-language-override
features.description: The font-language-override CSS property sets which language-specific glyphs are displayed.

features.name: IndexedDB getAllRecords()
features.description: The getAllRecords() method of IDBObjectStore and IDBIndex return records and their primary keys from an IndexedDB store or index. The records can be read in batches and in reverse order. The getAllRecords() methods speed up read operations on large datasets.

features.name: Hand input
features.description: An XRHand object, from the hand attribute of an XRInputSource object, represents a WebXR session's fully-articulated hand tracking model.

features.name: @function
features.description: The @function CSS at-rule defines a custom function that takes CSS values or custom properties as arguments, and returns a CSS value. It can be based on conditional logic such as by using the @media at-rule.

features.name: corner-shape
features.description: The corner-shape CSS property sets the shape of an element's corners when using border-radius, allowing for shapes other than rounded corners. For example, corner-shape: squircle is a shape in between a square and rounded corner.

features.name: Secure payment confirmation
features.description: The payment extension of a web authentication credential allows a relying party (such as a bank) to create a credential that can be queried by any merchant origin as part of an online checkout that uses the Payment Request API's secure-payment-confirmation payment method. Also known as SPC.

features.name: Speech recognition
features.description: The SpeechRecognition API converts audio into text using the device's speech recognition service.

features.name: scroll-target-group
features.description: The scroll-target-group CSS property sets the container where anchor links act as scroll markers. Using selectors such as :target-current, you can style elements when a target has scrolled into view. It's an alternative to the ::scroll-marker-group pseudo-element, which generates scroll markers.

features.name: scrollIntoView() container
features.description: The container option of the scrollIntoView() method sets which ancestor scroll container to scroll. The "nearest" value scrolls only the nearest ancestor, instead of the default "all".

features.name: Signature-based resource integrity
features.description: Signature-based resource integrity verifies a script's provenance by checking that the resource has been signed with a trusted key given by the <script> element's integrity attribute.

features.name: Interest invokers
features.description: Interest invokers, registered by the interestfor HTML attribute, trigger events and actions on a target element when a user shows interest in the element, through behaviors such as hover, focus, or long-press. Pseudo-elements apply styles to sources and targets of interest.

features.name: Local network access
features.description: The "local-network-access" user permission (and certain actions that imply this permission, such as a fetch() request with { targetAddressSpace: "local" }) allows a site to send requests to servers on a user's local network.

features.name: Range syntax for style queries
features.description: The @container style() CSS at-rule and if(style()) CSS function queries accept a range syntax, such as >, <, >=, <=, to query for inexact values.

features.name: Scroll marker target pseudo-classes
features.description: The :target-current CSS pseudo-class selects the active scroll marker (as in ::scroll-marker), while the :target-after and :target-before pseudo-classes select the inactive markers preceding and following the active scroll marker.

features.name: Anchor position container queries
features.description: Anchor position container queries with the @container anchored(fallback: …) at-rule apply styles to an element based on the element's anchor position.

features.name: Protected audience
features.description: The protected audience API facilitates advertisement sales by allowing sites to register users as part of an interest group or to choose which ads appear based on those interest groups, while minimizing the ability of advertisers to track specific members of the interest group. Also known as FLEDGE.

features.name: Anchor positioning transforms
features.description: Anchor positioned elements take CSS transforms on their anchor elements into account.

features.name: Temporal
features.description: The Temporal API allows you to work with dates, times, time zones, and durations. It is more powerful than the Date API.

features.name: overscroll-behavior
features.description: The overscroll-behavior CSS property disables default scrolling behaviors when the edges of a scrolling area are reached.

features.name: text-justify
features.description: The text-justify CSS property sets the justification method of text when text-align: justify is set.

features.name: autocorrect
features.description: The autocorrect global HTML attribute controls whether to automatically correct spelling or punctuation errors for user input.

features.name: <geolocation>
features.description: The <geolocation> HTML element represents a button that, upon activation, prompts the user to choose whether to grant the page access to geolocation data.

features.name: caret-shape
features.description: The caret-shape CSS property sets the shape of the insertion caret, the symbol that shows where the next character is to be inserted or deleted.

features.name: clipboardchange
features.description: The clipboardchange event for navigator.clipboard fires when the user modifies the clipboard's contents.

features.name: HTMLGeolocationElement initialPermissionStatus
features.description: The initialPermissionStatus property of the HTMLGeolocationElement API represents whether geolocation was previously granted, denied, or neither, when the page first loads.

features.name: WebGPU subgroups
features.description: The subgroups extension for the WebGPU Shading Language (WGSL) enables SIMD parallelism. Using subgroups, threads in a workgroup can efficiently communicate and perform collective operations.

features.name: Crash report storage
features.description: The window.crashReport object is a key-value store to record information about your application's state. If there's a crash, then the data in the key-value store is sent to your crash reporting endpoint, to help you pinpoint the cause of the crash.

features.name: Navigation timing confidence
features.description: The confidence property of a navigation performance entry describes whether the navigation metric is likely to be representative the page's performance (high confidence) or affected by transient conditions, such as browser startup (low confidence).

features.name: Navigation precommit handlers
features.description: The precommitHandler callback option to NavigateEvent's intercept() method returns a promise that defers navigation until the promise resolves. You can use this to change the navigation's URL, state, and history before navigation occurs.

features.name: Sanitizer API
features.description: The Sanitizer API customizes the sanitization of HTML parsed and inserted into the DOM in a way that can prevent cross-site scripting attacks. You can use it with DOM APIs that accept a sanitizer option, such as parseHTML() or setHTML().

features.name: <meta name="text-scale">
features.description: The <meta name="text-scale" content="scale" /> HTML element allows the browser's initial font size to be affected by the operating system text scale settings. The <meta name="text-scale" content="legacy" /> element is the default behavior that respects only browser font-size settings.

features.name: light-dark() image values
features.description: The light-dark() CSS function accepts, in addition to colors, two <image> values, such as a gradient or URL, and uses one depending on the current color scheme.

features.name: at-rule()
features.description: The at-rule() function, when used with @supports, checks if a CSS at-rule is supported. For example @supports at-rule(@starting-style) checks if the @starting-style at-rule is supported.

features.name: border-shape
features.description: The border-shape CSS property sets the geometry of the border box, changing the shape of any applicable border, border image, focus outline, or shadow.

features.name: Element-scoped view transitions
features.description: The startViewTransition() method of an Element object starts a view transition that affects only that element's DOM tree. You can use this to run separate elements' transitions concurrently.

features.name: Layers (WebXR)
features.description: WebXR layer types, such as XRCylinderLayer, XRCylinderLayer, XREquirectLayer, XRProjectionLayer or XRQuadLayer, are managed by the system compositor, to reduce latency or resampling.

features.name: Shared worker extended lifetime
features.description: The extendedLifetime option of the SharedWorker() constructor gives shared workers extra time to perform operations after all pages using it have been navigated away from or closed.

features.name: WEBGL_compressed_texture_pvrtc WebGL extension
features.description: The WEBGL_compressed_texture_pvrtc extension for WebGL 1.0 and 2.0 contexts adds PVRTC compressed texture formats to compressedTexImage2D() and compressedTexSubImage2D().

features.name: Animation accessors
features.description: The animation property of an AnimationEvent or TransitionEvent object is the Animation object that represents the animation (and thus the element) that fired an animation event.

features.name: alpha()
features.description: The alpha() CSS function computes a relative color value by adjusting the opacity of an origin color.

features.name: CSSPseudoElement
features.description: A CSSPseudoElement object represents a pseudo-element and its context in the document tree. You get an instance through the pseudo() method of Element or CSSPseudoElement objects or the pseudoTarget property of some events.

features.name: Gap decorations
features.description: The column-rule and row-rule CSS properties display decorative lines between columns and rows of a flex, grid, or multi-column layout. The rule-break, rule-outset, and rule-paint-order properties control the appearance of these lines.

features.name: <meta name="theme-color">
features.description: The name="theme-color" attribute for the <meta> HTML element suggests a color that the browser can use to customize the display of the page or the browser user interface.

features.name: <template for>
features.description: The <template for="…"> HTML element replaces the content at a named range or insertion point, marked by the processing instructions <?start name="…"> and <?end> or <?marker name="…">. You can use this to stream or "patch" partial updates into the document out of order.

features.name: flex-wrap: balance
features.description: The flex-wrap: balance CSS declaration distributes items in a multi-line flex container such that each line has about the same number of items.

features.name: HTML processing instructions
features.description: An HTML processing instruction is text enclosed by <? and >, which marks a target for further processing. They may appear anywhere in a document. They are ignored like comments when they're not recognized for a specific purpose.

features.name: integrity() for url()
features.description: The url() CSS function accepts an integrity() modifier to use subresource integrity to verify the response from the requested URL.

features.name: Lazy-loading media
features.description: The loading="lazy" attribute for

features.name: named-feature()
features.description: The named-feature() function, when used with @supports, checks if a named CSS behavior is supported. The CSS behavior names are defined by specification. For example, @supports named-feature(anchor-position-follows-transforms) checks whether anchor-positioning applies after transforms."

features.name: Scroll method promises
features.description: The scroll(), scrollBy(), scrollTo(), and scrollIntoView() methods on the Element and Window interfaces return Promises that resolve when scrolling completes.

features.name: text-fit
features.description: The text-fit CSS property scales text to fill the inline size of its container. You can use this to grow or shrink headlines, captions, or pull quotes to fit a container.

features.name: HTML media capture
features.description: The capture HTML attribute for <input type="file"> elements allows the user to capture media using the device's camera or microphone.

features.name: popover="hint"
features.description: The popover="hint" global HTML attribute creates a popover that is subordinate to popovers with a popover="auto" attribute. You can use this to create tooltips that don't dismiss auto popovers.

features.name: Interaction contentful paint performance entries
features.description: An interaction-contentful-paint performance entry measures the duration of an interaction that causes one or more contentful paints. You can use it to measure LCP for soft navigations in single page apps.

features.name: Soft navigation performance entries
features.description: A soft-navigation performance entry measures the duration of a soft navigation in a single page app. A soft navigation is defined as when a trusted user interaction causes a URL update and a visible contentful paint to the screen.

features.name: Wheel events momentum
features.description: The momentum property of a wheel event object is true when the event represents simulated scroll inertia, also known as a "fling" event.

features.name: Connection allowlists
features.description: The Connection-Allowlist HTTP response header limits which requests a page may initiate using fetch and other APIs.

features.name: Reference target
features.description: The referenceTarget property of a ShadowRoot object forwards attributes such as for and aria-labelledby to elements inside a shadow DOM. You can use this to, for example, link a <label> to its <input> even if the <input> is in the shadow DOM of a web component.

features.name: Iterator.zip() and Iterator.zipKeyed()
features.description: The Iterator.zip() and Iterator.zipKeyed() static methods return new iterators that aggregate items from multiple iterables. You can use them to iterate jointly, to get all of the items at the same position in each iterable.

features.name: WEBGL_compressed_texture_s3tc WebGL extension
features.description: The WEBGL_compressed_texture_s3tc extension for WebGL 1.0 and 2.0 contexts adds S3TC compressed texture formats to compressedTexImage2D() and compressedTexSubImage2D().

features.name: Iterator join()
features.description: The join() method of an Iterator object returns a string concatenation of all the iterator's items, separated by commas or a given separator string. It's similar to the join() method of arrays.

features.name: WEBGL_draw_buffers WebGL extension
features.description: The WEBGL_draw_buffers extension for WebGL 1.0 contexts enables a fragment shader to write to several textures, which is useful for deferred shading, for example.

features.name: Related apps
features.description: The related_applications web app manifest member lists operating system-specific applications that are related to the current web app, such as an Android app that provides similar functionality. The getInstalledRelatedApps() method lists which of those are installed on the current device.

features.name: Digital goods
features.description: The window.getDigitalGoodsService API connects to stores or billing services for in-app products and subscriptions.

features.name: Badging
features.description: The navigator.setAppBadge() method allows installed web applications to display an application badge, typically a dot or number shown alongside the application's icon on the device's home screen or application dock.

features.name: Screen orientation lock
features.description: The screen.orientation.lock() method prevents changes to the screen orientation, typically in fullscreen applications such as games. For example, while locked, rotating a phone to the side won't change the screen orientation from landscape to portrait.

features.name: accent-color
features.description: The accent-color CSS property sets a color for checkboxes, radio buttons, and other form controls.

features.name: Network Information
features.description: The navigator.connection API provides information about the network connection a device is using and fires events when the connection type changes.

features.name: Contact picker
features.description: The navigator.contacts API allows you to ask users to share limited details about entries in their contact list with your application.

features.name: Barcode detector
features.description: The BarcodeDetector API recognizes various barcode formats in images.

features.name: Content Index
features.description: The Content Index API allows developers to register their offline enabled content with the browser.

features.name: OVR_multiview2 WebGL extension
features.description: The OVR_multiview2 extension for WebGL 2.0 contexts renders into multiple views simultaneously. This especially useful for virtual reality (VR) and WebXR.

features.name: Web NFC
features.description: The NDEFReader API reads and writes messages to near-field communication (NFC) tags.

features.name: Iterator includes()
features.description: The includes() method of an Iterator object returns true when an item yielded by the iterator is the same as a given value. It's similar to the includes() method of arrays.

features.name: Responsive iframes
features.description: The frame-sizing CSS property sets the size of an <iframe> element to that of it contents, to avoid scrolling in the iframe. Embedded documents allow this with the <meta name="responsive-embedded-sizing"> element and request resizing in the embedding page by calling window.requestResize().

features.name: Notifications
features.description: The Notification() constructor shows a message to the user, typically using the notification system of the host operating system.

features.name: Screen capture
features.description: The navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia() method asks the user to choose a screen or portion of a screen (such as a window) to capture as a media stream.

features.name: registerProtocolHandler
features.description: The navigator.registerProtocolHandler() method declares a site's ability to handle an address scheme (also known as a protocol). For example, an email site can register to open mailto: URLs or a VoIP site to open tel: URLs.

features.name: display-mode media query
features.description: The display-mode CSS media query sets styles based on whether the web page is in an ordinary browser tab mode or another mode, such as fullscreen, standalone, or minimal-ui.

features.name: WebHID
features.description: The WebHID API provides access to Human Interface Devices (HID) that are connected to the user's device.

features.name: Eyedropper
features.description: The EyeDropper API opens an eyedropper tool, a color picker that allows users to select a color from their screen.

features.name: Protocol handlers
features.description: The protocol_handlers web app manifest member registers an installed web app as a handler for a specific protocol. When a user follows a link with the specified protocol, the installed app opens the link.

features.name: Capture Handle
features.description: The capture handle API allows you to share a custom handle (a string) from a web application being captured by getDisplayMedia() to the capturing web application.

features.name: File handlers
features.description: The file_handlers web app manifest member registers an installed web app as a handler for files with specific file extensions or MIME types.

features.name: Local fonts
features.description: The window.queryLocalFonts() method returns an array of locally-installed fonts, each represented by a FontData object.

features.name: Region capture
features.description: When using navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia() to capture a browser tab as a video stream, the region capture API allows you to crop the video to the bounding box of a given element. In contrast to the element capture API, any content that overlays that element is also captured.

features.name: Window Controls Overlay
features.description: The display_override: ["window-controls-overlay"] web application manifest member shows content in the title bar area of a progressive web app that is installed on a desktop device.

features.name: Launch handler
features.description: The launch_handler web app manifest member, with the client_mode property, configure how web app launches behave when an instance of the app is already open. For example, you can choose to focus the existing app instance instead of launching a new one.

features.name: Window management
features.description: The window.getScreenDetails() method gets information about the screens on a device, which you can use to place new windows on a specific screen with window.open().

features.name: Document picture-in-picture
features.description: The document picture-in-picture API creates an always-on-top window from arbitrary HTML content.

features.name: CPU compute pressure
features.description: The PressureObserver API monitors CPU load, allowing you to adjust workloads in response to available computing resources. Also known as the Compute Pressure API.

features.name: Element capture
features.description: The restrictTo() method on screen capture media tracks limits capture to a specific element, excluding content which might occlude the element itself, such as video conferencing controls.

features.name: Summarizer
features.description: The Summarizer API uses an on-device language model to summarize text.

features.name: Language detector
features.description: The LanguageDetector API identifies the likely natural language that some text is written in. You can use this API to supplement machine translation when the source source language is not known.

features.name: Translator
features.description: The Translator API translates some text from one natural language to another, using machine translation.

features.name: Non-cookie storage access
features.description: Non-cookie storage access extends the requestStorageAccess() API to let content in cross-site iframes request access to first-party data beyond cookies.

features.name: Web app origin migration
features.description: The migrate_to and migrate_from web app manifest members move an installed app from one origin to another, within the same site. They preserve the user's installation settings on the device, like shortcuts.

features.name: window-drag
features.description: The window-drag: move CSS declaration sets an element as a window drag handle, like a device's app title bar. You can use this to add click-and-drag areas to an installed progressive web app, often alongside window controls overlay.

features.name: LanguageModel
features.description: The LanguageModel API prompts an on-device language model. Also known as the Prompt API.

features.name: JPEG XL
features.description: The JPEG XL image format is a raster graphics file format that supports animation, alpha transparency, and lossy as well as lossless compression.

features.name: fastSeek()
features.description: The fastSeek() method seeks an <audio> or <video> element as fast as possible, by seeking to a keyframe instead of exactly the requested time.

features.name: Fetch form data
features.description: The Request.formData() and Response.formData() methods read a request or response body and return a FormData promise. You can use it to access the fields of a form submission.

features.name: WebVTT cue alignment
features.description: The WebVTT cue alignment settings control which part of the cue is aligned with the given line and position. Cue alignment is set using line and position settings in WebVTT files or the lineAlign and positionAlign properties of VTTCue using JavaScript.

features.name: WebVTT regions
features.description: WebVTT regions set the areas of the video where captions or subtitles should be rendered, such as placing roll-up captions used for live captions.

features.name: color-adjust
features.description: The color-adjust shorthand CSS property allows multiple performance related color adjustments to be set at once. Setting the print-color-adjust CSS property directly is preferred, as it is the only such adjustment so far defined.

features.name: iterationComposite
features.description: The iterationComposite property of a KeyframeEffect object sets whether an animation's iterations are calculated independently ("replace") or are accumulated with the value of the previous iteration ("accumulate").

features.name: Media element pseudo-classes
features.description: The :playing, :paused, :seeking, :buffering, :stalled, :muted, and :volume-locked CSS pseudo-classes match <audio> and <video> elements based on their state.

features.name: Clearing site data
features.description: The Clear-Site-Data header deletes browsing data (such as cookies, storage, or cache) associated with the requesting website.

features.name: glyph-orientation-vertical
features.description: The glyph-orientation-vertical CSS property sets the orientation of glyphs in text rendered in a vertical writing mode.

features.name: Audio and video tracks
features.description: The audioTracks and videoTracks APIs for media elements switch audio and video tracks during playback.

features.name: MediaController
features.description: The playback of multiple <video> or <audio> elements can be coordinated by a MediaController instance, for example to synchronize a sign-language interpreter track with the main video track.

features.name: cross-fade()
features.description: The cross-fade() CSS function generates an image by mixing two images.

features.name: CSS object model (DOM level 2)
features.description: The DOM level 2 style specification defined interfaces to access and modify CSS styles, such as CSSValue and CSSPrimitiveValue, that were later excluded from the CSS object model.

features.name: filter()
features.description: The filter() CSS function applies one or more graphic effects to a CSS image, such as a background image. You can use functions, such as blur() and drop-shadow(), alone or combined to produce different effects. For instance, background: filter(url(image.png), blur(2px)).

features.name: inverted-colors media query
features.description: The inverted-colors CSS media query sets styles based on whether the user has inverted all colors, such as with mobile accessibility settings.

features.name: scroll-axis-lock
features.description: The scroll-axis-lock property controls whether scrolling is locked to one dimension at a time or freely follows movement in two dimensions. By default, browsers may lock the scroll axis, ignoring minor perpendicular scrolling, when scrolling is nearly vertical or horizontal.

features.name: speak-as
features.description: The speak-as CSS property sets how any element's content is spoken. Not to be confused with the speak-as descriptor of @counter-style at-rules.

features.name: SVG 1.1
features.description: The SVG 1.1 image format has several components that were excluded from SVG 2, such as fonts, alternate glyphs, and the xlink namespace.

features.name: UI fonts
features.description: The ui-serif, ui-sans-serif, ui-monospace and ui-rounded values for the font-family CSS property use device-default user interface fonts for text.

features.name: Private click measurement
features.description: The attributionsourceid and attributiondestination attributes for <a> elements measure clicks across websites without associating a click to a specific session. Not to be confused with attribution reporting. Also known as PCM.

features.name: Audio session
features.description: The navigator.audioSession API controls how audio playback interacts with other applications. For example, playing music can pause audio from other applications, while ambient audio can play at the same time.

features.name: margin-trim
features.description: The margin-trim CSS property removes the margins of child elements when they meet the edges of the container.

features.name: Managed media source
features.description: The ManagedMediaSource API is a MediaSource where the browser manages the memory of source buffers and may evict data if needed.

features.name: mask-border
features.description: The mask-border CSS property sets how the edges of an element are masked. It is a shorthand for mask-border-outset, mask-border-repeat, mask-border-slice, mask-border-source, and mask-border-width.

features.name: <input type="checkbox" switch>
features.description: The switch attribute, when present on an <input type="checkbox"> HTML element, renders a switch control with an on and off state instead of a checkbox control.

features.name: Insertable streams for MediaStreamTrack
features.description: The MediaStreamTrackProcessor and MediaStreamTrackGenerator APIs modify the contents of a media track for merging streams, applying real-time effects like funny hats, and content overlays.

features.name: ruby-overhang
features.description: The ruby-overhang CSS property sets whether ruby annotations may overlap adjacent text.

features.name: alpha and colorspace attributes for <input type=color>
features.description: The ability to control the opacity of a color picked using <input type="color"> and determine the colorspace of the selected color.

features.name: font-width
features.description: The font-width CSS property selects a font face from a font family based on width, either by a keyword such as condensed or a percentage.

features.name: anchors-valid and anchors-visible
